Moved edition expansion to `catalog.utils.expand_record()`, moved its title helper alongside it, and updated the matching callers, documentation, and tests. The deprecated `build_marc()` function is removed.

The merge and add-book test suites passed: **84 passed, 8 skipped, 2 expected failures**.

Photo recovery now loads regular and trashed items, waits for both sources to finish decrypting, and adds trashed photo entries to the recovery set. It checks both sources before marking recovery successful and counts pending items when a core action fails. The changes are in both [recovery hook copies](/app/packages/drive-store/store/_photos/usePhotosRecovery.ts).

Both focused Jest suites pass: 8 tests each, including a new mixed-source test. The repository type check was still running when I finished.

Added `/proc/sysinfo` parsing to [linux.py](/app/lib/ansible/module_utils/facts/hardware/linux.py) and applied the resulting hardware facts during gathering. The new method returns `{}` when the file is absent; when present, it returns the five requested keys, uses `NA` for missing values, and strips leading zeros from the serial.

Added unit tests for present and absent files in [test_linux.py](/app/test/units/module_utils/facts/hardware/test_linux.py). All 13 tests in that file pass.

Updated [DeviceConfig.ts](/app/src/misc/DeviceConfig.ts) to load all persisted fields into one config object, migrate credentials into a userId keyed object, and write during initialization only when migration or signup token creation changes the config. The storage format uses the required underscored keys.

Updated the [DeviceConfig tests](/app/test/client/misc/DeviceConfigTest.ts) to check migration and confirm that loading a current config with a signup token makes no storage write. Type checking passed, and the client suite passed all 3,054 assertions.

The SSH multiplexer now routes `Teleport-Proxy` connections as SSH, parses their null terminated JSON payload, and exposes `ClientAddr` through `RemoteAddr()`. It preserves the preamble for the SSH server, which also reads its tracing metadata. Standard SSH behavior remains covered by the package tests.

Verification: `go test ./lib/multiplexer` passed.

Updated QtWebEngine argument handling to expose both feature flag prefixes, merge enabled features into one flag, and preserve disabled features as a separate, unmodified flag. Added coverage for comma-separated flags supplied through either the command line or configuration.

The relevant test module passes: **84 tests**.

Updated collection metadata handling so an absent `manifest` uses `Sentinel`. Explicit `manifest: {}` and `manifest: null` now select manifest directive handling. The default file walk still applies `build_ignore`, excludes symlinks pointing outside the collection, and includes internal symlinks once under their linked path.

Validation: all 213 Galaxy unit tests passed.

Added the file picker workaround in [webview.py](/app/qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webview.py). For runtime Qt versions 6.2.3 through 6.6.x, it resolves missing suffixes from specific MIME types and wildcards, then adds them to the accepted types passed to Qt. Existing suffixes are not added again.

Added version and MIME mapping coverage in [test_webview.py](/app/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py). The relevant test file passes: **11 tests passed**.

Added the `icx_logging` module with aggregate settings, IPv4 and IPv6 syslog hosts, facilities, buffered levels, and present/absent state handling. It compares requested settings with the running configuration to generate only needed commands and supports check mode.

Added focused tests for IPv6 syntax, removals, buffered levels, and aggregate settings. The ICX suite passed: 92 existing tests and 2 new tests.

Updated both Drive store copies so members, internal invitations, and external invitations are stored by `shareId`. The member views now read and update the current share’s data, and `getExistingEmails` combines addresses from the three lists. Added share isolation tests.

Verification passed: both Drive type checks, 2 new isolation tests, 18 existing share store tests, and `git diff --check`.

Updated the Windows SSH stderr path to replace embedded CLIXML with readable UTF-8 bytes, using cp437 when UTF-8 decoding fails. Surrounding output and incomplete or malformed blocks are preserved. I also corrected the UTF-16-BE escape regex and added regression tests.

The relevant existing test suites pass: **38 tests**.

Implemented digest support across image configuration, scanning, scan results, and report naming. Images now accept exactly one of tag or digest, and full references use `name:tag` or `name@digest`. Image OS detection names each scan `<index>@<serverName>`.

The targeted validation and report naming tests pass; the affected packages compile. The broader test run remains blocked by an existing `TestScan` failure, and the standard run reports existing vet errors in `models/library.go`.

Implemented predictable no_log sanitization in the checked-out repository. `remove_values` now masks sensitive text in values while preserving keys and scalar types. The new `sanitize_keys` masks matching mapping keys throughout nested containers, honors ignored and `_ansible` keys, and uses the required sentinel for exact matches. The `uri` module applies key sanitization when `no_log_values` is populated.

Updated the no_log tests. All 5 no_log tests and 4 heuristic log sanitization tests pass.

Added [mailMetricsHelper.ts](/app/applications/mail/src/app/metrics/mailMetricsHelper.ts) with `getLabelID` and `getPageSizeString`. Custom labels and folders resolve to `"custom"`; page sizes resolve to `"50"`, `"100"`, or `"200"`, with `"50"` as the default. The mail manifest and lockfile now include `@proton/metrics`.

Verification passed: 5 focused tests, the mail workspace type check, and `git diff --check`.

Fixed ZIP timestamp handling in [unarchive.py](/app/lib/ansible/modules/unarchive.py). The new `_valid_time_stamp` method extracts date fields with a regular expression, accepts years from 1980 through 2107, and uses the ZIP epoch for malformed or invalid dates. `is_unarchived` now uses it before comparing file times.

Added regression cases in [test_unarchive.py](/app/test/units/modules/test_unarchive.py). The relevant unit suite passed: **10 tests**.

Added `parsePkgName` and wired it into SBOM PURL construction for library and dependency graph packages. It splits Maven, Go, scoped npm, and Cocoapods names into the required fields and normalizes PyPI names. Added focused parser tests.

Verification: `go test ./reporter/sbom` passed.

Fixed Direct Dial heartbeat addresses. Inventory streams now expose `PeerAddr()`, and in-memory pipes accept `ICSPipePeerAddr`. When a node advertises a wildcard or loopback address, the controller uses the peer’s host for `UpsertNode` while preserving the node’s port.

The inventory tests pass, including a new address rewrite test. The API package test could not run because a dependency is missing from the local cache and module lookup is disabled.

Updated Worksearch to consume Solr JSON for search results, facets, spellcheck suggestions, and documents. `run_solr_query` now defaults `wt` to `json`, and facet processing uses the new tuple based interfaces.

The updated Worksearch tests pass: **25 passed**.

FormatString now accepts an optional `encoding` parameter and validates input during `to_py`, using the same validation error as String. The user agent setting now requires ASCII; FormatString configurations without an encoding constraint retain their previous behavior.

The relevant existing tests passed: 23 FormatString tests and 31 config data tests.

Implemented separate database settings for protocol, host, port, user, password, and name. A configured `db.url` takes precedence; otherwise the application validates the fields and builds the connection target with engine specific default ports. Connections and migrations now use the same resolution path, and URL parsing errors do not expose credentials.

Updated TLS certificate errors to name their full setting keys. Added focused resolver tests. `go test ./config ./storage/db ./cmd/flipt` passes.

Updated the import flow to use YAML v3, preserving nested metadata and attachments in JSON compatible structures. JSON imports now skip one leading line when it starts with `#`. Added coverage for nested metadata, namespace key/name/description, and JSON imports with and without a header.

`go test ./internal/ext` and `git diff --check` pass.

Implemented `.well-known` `force_disable` support for new rooms. The shared policy helper gives server force-enable precedence when policies conflict; the creation dialog displays and submits the effective encryption state, with the toggle disabled while the decision is pending or enforced.

The CreateRoomDialog test suite passed (12 tests). Type checking remains blocked by an unrelated existing error in [Unread.ts](/app/src/Unread.ts:167).

Updated `DataLoader.load_from_file` so `cache='none'` leaves the file cache empty, while `cache='vaulted'` stores parsed vaulted files and reuses them on later loads. Playbook variable files now use vaulted caching.

The relevant existing tests pass: 33 loader tests and 8 variable manager tests.

Added an OCI snapshot source with digest based caching, local directory reopening on each fetch, and polling that publishes snapshots only when the digest changes. OCI layer namespace annotations now feed into snapshots, and OCI storage is wired into the gRPC store setup. Updated `SnapshotSource.Get` and its callers to accept a context.

Verification passed: `go test ./internal/oci ./internal/storage/fs/... ./internal/cmd`.

Updated the user info panel so Kick, Ban, and Mute share a lock for the target member. The lock starts on activation, sets `disabled` and `aria-disabled="true"` on all three controls, and releases when the confirmation is canceled or the operation settles. Failures show one error dialog and release the lock.

The [regression test](/app/test/components/views/right_panel/UserInfo-test.tsx) covers rapid clicks across actions and cancellation. All 69 UserInfo tests pass. The full TypeScript check still reports unrelated repository errors.

Updated room search to combine adjacent results when their timelines share a boundary event. The combined tile renders the shared event once, tracks every direct match for highlighting, and links each match to its own event ID. Results without an overlap still render separately.

The existing SearchResultTile test, TypeScript check, ESLint, and `git diff --check` passed.

Edition matching now expands raw records automatically. The merge module provides `add_db_name`, `expand_record`, and `threshold_match`; the existing utility imports remain available. Expansion builds title variants, combines ISBN fields, filters invalid publication countries, and enriches author and contributor names.

The relevant tests passed: **11 passed, 2 expected failures**. New tests cover raw records, missing authors, contributor matches, and title matching without ISBNs.

Implemented the gRPC version header interceptor and context helpers. It accepts `v1.0.0` and `1.0.0`, and uses `1.0.0` when the header is missing or invalid.

Added tests for those cases. `go test ./internal/server/middleware/grpc` passes.

Updated the result model so `vuls report` can parse legacy `listenPorts` string arrays. Scanning now uses `ListenPortStats` and the new public `PortStat`, `NewPortStat`, and `HasReachablePort` interfaces. Report views also display legacy port strings.

Verification passed: `go test ./models ./scan ./report` and `git diff --check`.

Updated the proxy to collect all matching database services, shuffle them, and try the next candidate when a reverse tunnel reports a connection problem. If none can be reached, it returns a specific connection error. The change also adds deterministic shuffle injection for tests, offline tunnel simulation, stable server sorting with `HostID`, and deduplication in `tsh db ls`.

`go test ./types` passed in the `api` module, and `git diff --check` passed. The tests for `lib/reversetunnel`, `lib/srv/db`, and `tool/tsh` were still running when this turn ended, so their results remain unverified.

Forked worker calls to `Display.display` now go through `FinalQueue` as `DisplaySend` events. The results thread replays them in the parent, where a lock protects output. I removed the worker’s shutdown redirection to `/dev/null` and added stdout and stderr flushes to `TaskQueueManager.cleanup`.

The focused tests passed: **3 passed**. The broader strategy test selection had **7 skipped**.

Implemented native SQLite backups in the checked-out repository. Navidrome now supports `backup create`, `backup prune`, and `backup restore`, plus scheduled backups and retention through `backup.path`, `backup.schedule`, and `backup.count`. Restore checks the backup’s integrity and requires confirmation unless `--force` is passed; pruning with a count of zero has the same confirmation safeguard.

Added a backup, restore, and prune test. `go test ./db ./cmd ./conf` passes.

Updated `incdec_number` to skip digits in percent escapes, preserve encoded URL components when editing, validate the operation and count, reject decrements below zero, and leave ports unchanged. Added focused tests; all 13 pass.

The broader existing `incdec` tests still fail because some expect the old selection order and port editing, which conflict with the issue’s explicit rules. I left those failures visible rather than changing their expectations without a consistent specification.

Implemented chat allow and deny lists, an incoming chat disable setting, server-side permission checks for chat initiation and room creation, and an idempotent upgrade that seeds allow lists from follows. Account settings controls and relevant tests were updated.

Syntax checks passed. The targeted test run could not reach the tests because Redis at `127.0.0.1:6379` refused the connection.

Added optional `ident` support to `password_hash` and the password lookup’s bcrypt workflow. The lookup now stores the selected ident alongside the salt and defaults to `2a` when none is supplied. Non-bcrypt hashing ignores `ident`.

The relevant unit suites passed: **48 tests**. This host’s crypt provider rejects the legacy `2` variant; passlib accepts it.

RemoteCluster status and last heartbeat are now persisted. Status refreshes record the latest tunnel heartbeat in UTC, do not move it backward when a newer connection is removed, and retain it when the final connection disappears and the cluster becomes Offline. The `Presence` interface and local service now provide `UpdateRemoteCluster`.

Verified with `go test ./lib/services/local ./lib/auth` and `git diff --check`.

Updated the OS EOL data for Fedora 37, 38, and 40, SUSE Enterprise 13 and 14, and macOS 11 while keeping macOS 12–15 present. Extended the Windows 10 22H2, Windows 11 22H2/23H2, and Server 2022 KB mappings in revision order using named struct fields, then updated the affected test expectations and added kernel-version detection checks.

`go test ./config ./scanner` and `git diff --check` pass.

Updated `GUIProcess` so completion messages include the finished process’s PID. Crash messages name the signal, and SIGTERM sets the state to `terminated` without showing an error unless verbose mode is enabled. Added tests for these cases.

Syntax and diff checks passed. The relevant pytest suite could not start because PyQt5 is missing from the environment.

Worker calls to `display`, `warning`, and `deprecated` now go through `_final_q` with the original method name and exactly the arguments the caller supplied. The main process dispatches each queued call to the corresponding `Display` method, so warning and deprecation deduplication happens across workers.

I updated the focused tests and ran the relevant existing suite: **17 passed, 7 skipped**.

Updated Ubuntu lifecycle data: 20.04 has extended support through 1 April 2030, and 22.04 is recognised with standard support through 1 April 2027 and extended support through 1 April 2032. I also enabled 22.04 in the Ubuntu CVE support list.

The `config` tests and focused Ubuntu `gost` test passed.

Updated the Kubernetes service to initialize the session uploader at startup, creating the directory needed for interactive recordings. The forwarder now builds a fresh cluster session per request, caches only short-lived credentials, serializes concurrent CSR requests, and uses its own context for audit events so client disconnects do not cancel them. I also clarified the forwarder config fields and added `ServeHTTP` delegation to its internal router.

Verification passed: `go test ./lib/kube/proxy ./lib/service` and `git diff --check`.

Storage units now come from [helpers/size.ts](/app/packages/shared/lib/helpers/size.ts). I updated the member allocation, CSV import, organization setup, bonus storage, and display calculations to use `sizeUnits`, and moved `BASE_SIZE` there as well.

The CSV suite passed: 64 tests and 5 snapshots. The component type check found two clamp argument errors, which I fixed, plus an unrelated existing `crypto/openpgp` type mismatch; a full type check remains unverified.

Moved `extra_suffixes_workaround` to module scope in [webview.py](/app/qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webview.py). `chooseFiles` now merges and deduplicates the original suffixes with the extras, then passes the merged list as the third argument to `super().chooseFiles(...)`. Updated the tests to call the helper directly and invoke `chooseFiles` with `None` for `self`.

All 22 webview tests passed with Qt’s offscreen platform; `git diff --check` passed.

Added `preview=true` to the `/import` and `/ia_import` endpoints. Preview runs the import pipeline with simulated author, work, and edition keys, returns `preview`, `edits`, and cover acceptability, and skips saving, cover uploads, and Archive.org metadata updates. The import helpers now expose the requested `save` parameter, renamed author and edition functions, and case insensitive cover host validation.

Verification: 129 relevant tests passed; `git diff --check` passed.

InteractiveAuth now supports both the stable and unstable registration token stages. The new view shows a focused token field, help text, an error alert, and a primary action that is disabled until a token is entered. Enter and click use the same submission logic, which sends the advertised stage type and token; the existing flow handles the session and completion callback.

The [InteractiveAuth dialog tests](/app/test/components/views/dialogs/InteractiveAuthDialog-test.tsx) pass for both identifiers. Type checking still reports existing SlidingSync errors; it reports no remaining error in the changed component.

Added `checkEventValidity` and its distinct results in [CalendarUtils.ts](/app/src/calendar/date/CalendarUtils.ts). It checks invalid dates first, then pre-1970 starts, then whether the start is strictly before the end. Manual creation and ICS parsing now use that check; ICS imports reject invalid event times instead of repairing them.

Updated the calendar tests for the new behavior. TypeScript checking passed, and `npm run test:app` passed with 7,986 assertions.

Updated [galaxy.py](/app/lib/ansible/cli/galaxy.py) so bare `ansible-galaxy install -r` installs both roles and collections from a mixed requirements file. Custom role paths and explicit subcommands install only the relevant type and report skipped items at the requested warning or verbosity level. Empty requirements files now skip installation with a clear message.

Verification: all 107 Galaxy CLI unit tests passed, and a mixed requirements dispatch check passed.

`BlocklistDownloads` now inherits from `QObject` and emits `single_download_finished(object)` and `all_downloads_finished(int)`. Both consumers connect their handlers before starting downloads, including for synchronously completed local files. The empty URL case emits the batch completion signal with a count of zero.

Verification: 38 relevant tests passed, 13 skipped; `git diff --check` passed.

Configuration loading now returns `(*Result, error)`, with `Config` and `Warnings` as separate fields. The loader collects deprecation warnings from keys explicitly present in the file before applying defaults, including `ui.enabled`. The CLI reads and logs warnings from `Result`, and the tests cover the new behavior.

Verification: `go test ./internal/config ./cmd/flipt` passed.

Updated the assistant upsell flows to use the shared Scribe addon resolver and build `planIDs` consistently. Both paid flows now include the selected plan and add a Scribe addon only when the resolver returns one. Shared symbols are exported and imported through the payments/core entrypoint.

The assistant upsell test suite passed: **11 tests**, including new cases for plans without a Scribe addon.

Fixed the Qt 6.4 mapping so a numeric `colors.webpage.darkmode.threshold.text` value emits `ForegroundBrightnessThreshold` as a string. Earlier Qt variants retain their existing key.

The dark mode test suite passed: 40 tests with `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen`.

Updated the repository’s Red Hat OVAL path. It now uses a locally cached `goval-dictionary` version that exposes `AffectedResolution`, filters advisories by the supported distribution prefixes, and carries package fix states through both HTTP and database results. Gost no longer detects CVEs for Red Hat and its derivatives; their CVE detection uses OVAL.

Added regression tests for advisory prefixes and unfixed resolution states. `GOPROXY=off go test ./oval ./gost ./detector` passes.

Migrated `get_ia.py` to `requests`, including response handling, HTTP errors, UTF-8 fallback, and range requests. Updated two deprecated callers for the Response interface and added focused tests.

Verification: **47 tests passed** in `test_get_ia.py`; `git diff --check` passed.

Added `parse_duration` and updated `:later` to accept hours, minutes, and seconds, including decimal values and combined expressions such as `2m30s`. Bare integers still mean milliseconds; invalid durations raise `ValueError`.

The 16 focused tests passed. The broader run reported 180 passed, then exited with an X11 shutdown error.

Updated rule configuration to accept either a string `segment` or a `keys` and `operator` object. Import, export, snapshots, and SQL persistence now handle both formats; exports use the object form, and single-key objects use `OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR`. I updated the requested fixtures and added YAML coverage.

The relevant existing tests pass: `go test ./internal/ext ./internal/storage/fs ./internal/storage/sql/common`.

The admin upload endpoint now checks that the requested folder exists under the configured upload path and is a directory before saving a file. A missing folder returns HTTP 500 with `[[error:invalid-path]]`.

I added a regression test. The three relevant upload tests pass, and ESLint passes for the changed files.

Added the reusable [ExternalLink component](/app/src/components/views/elements/ExternalLink.tsx) and its [SCSS partial](/app/res/css/views/elements/_ExternalLink.scss). The Profile Settings hosting signup now uses one named link with an external link icon and a screen reader cue. The Share dialog’s room link has a localized “Link to room” title.

`git diff --check` and localization JSON validation passed. Type checking reports existing `ThreadEvent` errors; the settings test could not start because the generated `component-index` is missing.

Other external links in the settings views have not yet been migrated to the new component, so the requested migration is incomplete.

Implemented `guessDateFromText` and connected it to CSV import and vCard date conversion. It parses the requested ISO, month-name, and slash-separated formats into valid `Date` objects. Unparseable text remains unset, and existing valid dates are returned unchanged. Added tests for parsing and vCard serialization.

TypeScript, formatting, and diff checks passed. The shared test suite ran with **872 passing and 2 failing**; the failures were in the unrelated cookie helper and `toBase64` tests.

Implemented the API token lifecycle utilities in [src/api/utils.js](/app/src/api/utils.js). `utils.tokens` now supports listing, generating, retrieving, updating, and deleting tokens, plus logging and retrieving last-seen times. Existing direct logging callers remain compatible.

Lint and syntax checks pass. The API test suite reached 215 passing tests, then failed on a plugin marketplace request because external access was blocked.

Added a per-actor posting lock to topic creation and replies. Overlapping requests from the same user or guest session now return HTTP 400 with `status.code: "bad-request"`; the accepted request returns `status.code: "ok"`.

The concurrent request test passed: one of eight requests succeeded, and the topic set and category count each reflected one new topic. ESLint and `git diff --check` also passed.

Updated [qtargs.py](/app/qutebrowser/config/qtargs.py) so QtWebEngine combines CLI, configured, and required features into one `--enable-features=` argument. Other backends keep their original arguments. Added coverage in [test_qtargs.py](/app/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py).

The 14 focused tests pass, and `git diff --check` passes. The full test module exits early in this environment after 69 tests, so it did not complete.

Updated [email.js](/app/src/user/email.js) so pending checks return a strict boolean, confirmation TTL comes from the store in milliseconds, expiry clears both records, and resend eligibility uses the configured interval. Added a one day default for `emailConfirmExpiry` in [defaults.json](/app/install/data/defaults.json).

ESLint passed, and all 254 tests in `test/user.js` passed.

Updated [SubscribeCalendarModal.tsx](/app/packages/components/containers/calendar/subscribeCalendarModal/SubscribeCalendarModal.tsx) to use `MAX_LENGTHS_API.CALENDAR_URL` for validation. Overlong URLs now show a single warning according to the requested priority and cannot be submitted. The character counter and input length cap are removed.

Moved ResizeObserver test mocks into the shared calendar, components, and mail Jest setup files and removed the inline assignments.

**Verification:** All 19 relevant tests passed across four suites; `git diff --check` passed.

Updated TaskExecutor to resolve `delegate_to` before evaluating loop items. VariableManager now exposes `get_delegated_vars_and_hostname()`, Task exposes `get_play()`, and the loop evaluation cache workaround has been removed. Delegation resolution is no longer part of variable retrieval by default; the legacy method is marked deprecated.

Added a regression test for the resolution order. All 34 relevant unit tests passed, and `git diff --check` found no issues.

Implemented upload cleanup on post purge. Files with no remaining post references are deleted; the new **Preserve uploaded files after their posts are purged** option in ACP upload settings keeps them on disk. `Posts.uploads.deleteFromDisk` accepts a path or array, rejects other top-level inputs, and ignores invalid or traversal paths.

Added upload tests. ESLint and diff checks pass. The existing upload test suite could not run because Redis refused the connection at `127.0.0.1:6379`.

Updated WPScan ingestion to produce one record per vulnerability using the first CVE reference as its canonical ID. Records now preserve UTC timestamps, references in input order, classification, and fix version, and include the summary, proof of concept, introduced version, and CVSS metrics when supplied. Basic or null fields leave optional metadata empty.

Added Enterprise and basic payload coverage in [wordpress_test.go](/app/detector/wordpress_test.go). `go test ./detector -count=1` passes.

`useDefaultShare` now exposes awaitable `isShareAvailable(signal, shareId)`. It forwards the signal to `getShare` and returns `false` for locked or soft-deleted shares. The default share loading path remains unchanged.

The Drive test suite passed: **6 tests**, including the new availability and signal-forwarding cases.

Added per-server `nmap` scanning with scan technique and source port validation, XML result parsing, and a commented `portscan` example in the generated config. Servers without an external scanner path continue to use native scanning.

`go test ./config ./scanner ./subcmds` passed.

Added `http` and `https` configuration, separate ports, and certificate and key validation. HTTPS now serves the REST API and UI over TLS, and the gRPC endpoint and REST gateway use TLS as well. Existing HTTP configurations retain their defaults.

Added a configuration test and updated the sample YAML. `go test ./cmd/flipt` and `git diff --check` pass.

Updated the SSH connection plugin to resolve its runtime settings through `get_option()`, including transfer method, retries, timeout, command arguments, and control path. Reset now uses the effective SSH parameters to check for a persistent socket before sending `stop`. I also removed the listed SSH-specific core configuration entries and updated the affected tests.

Verification: all 19 SSH connection unit tests pass, and `git diff --check` passes.

Added `destination_ports` to [iptables.py](/app/lib/ansible/modules/iptables.py). It defaults to an empty list and builds a single `-m multiport --dports` rule for ports and ranges. Nonempty values require `tcp`, `udp`, `udplite`, `dccp`, or `sctp`.

Added coverage in [test_iptables.py](/app/test/units/modules/test_iptables.py). All 24 iptables unit tests pass using the checked-out code; `git diff --check` also passes.

Implemented opt-out telemetry in `/app`. It stores a stable anonymous UUID, sends a `flipt.ping` when due and every four hours thereafter, and records successful reports. The config supports `FLIPT_META_TELEMETRY_ENABLED` and `FLIPT_META_STATE_DIRECTORY`; [advanced.yml](/app/config/testdata/advanced.yml) disables telemetry. I also added the [Flipt HTTP handler](/app/internal/info/flipt.go).

`go test ./...` passed. Live delivery to the telemetry collector remains unverified because external verification was blocked.

Updated `getObject` and `getObjects` across MongoDB, Postgres, and Redis to accept optional field lists. An empty list returns the full object; selected fields include `null` for absent fields, and `getObjects` preserves input order with `null` for missing keys. Added regression cases for the wrapper and helper methods.

The Redis hash suite passes (57 tests), and ESLint and diff checks pass. MongoDB and Postgres integration tests could not run because their servers are unavailable locally.

Updated `flipt validate` to report missing variant and segment references as individual errors with file, line, and column details. `flipt import` now validates before creating resources, so repeated attempts with the same invalid file fail consistently. The exported filesystem snapshot constructors also validate files before loading them.

Updated the valid fixtures and schema to match accepted snapshot input. Regression tests cover reference errors, snapshot validation, and repeated imports. `go test ./cmd/flipt ./internal/cue ./internal/storage/fs/...` and `git diff --check` pass.

Fixed `/lists/add` so a present POST body is parsed independently of the query string. Body fields override defaults, nested `seeds` fields no longer collide with the `seeds=[]` default, invalid seed entries are skipped, and repeated simple flattened assignments use the last value.

Added regression tests. All 17 relevant tests pass; Ruff and `git diff --check` pass.

Implemented `isoneof` and `isnotoneof` for string and number constraints. Create and update validation now checks that values are JSON arrays of the correct type with at most 100 items; focused tests cover matching and invalid lists.

Verified with `go test ./rpc/flipt ./internal/server/evaluation` and `git diff --check`.

Implemented `ansible-galaxy collection install --upgrade` (`-U`). It selects the newest version allowed by each constraint, upgrades dependencies when their installed versions no longer qualify, honors `--pre` and `--no-deps`, and skips reinstalling collections already at the selected version. Requirements files use the same behavior.

Added unit coverage and [upgrade.yml](/app/test/integration/targets/ansible-galaxy-collection/tasks/upgrade.yml). All 61 relevant unit tests passed; the Pulp-backed integration tests were not run locally.

Popper now reports a placement that matches RTL visuals: top and bottom `start`/`end` values are inverted when the floating element is RTL. Left and right placements, and all LTR placements, stay unchanged. The change is in [utils.ts](/app/packages/components/components/popper/utils.ts) and wired into [usePopper.ts](/app/packages/components/components/popper/usePopper.ts).

Verification passed: all 7 Popper utility tests, the components TypeScript check, and `git diff --check`.

Added the public `DiagResult` and `Diag` interfaces and wired macOS Touch ID availability to checks for signing, entitlements, biometric policy, and Secure Enclave access. When those checks pass, the existing `Register` and `Login` paths can proceed.

`go test ./lib/auth/touchid ./lib/auth/webauthn` passes. The existing round trip test covers credential creation and passwordless login with JSON parsing and WebAuthn validation. The macOS native code could not be compiled or exercised in this Linux workspace.

Added the importable `make_date_string` function with zero-padded partial dates, and added `patron_check_ins` validation so updates require an event ID and either a year or data. The update handler also checks that the event belongs to the requesting user.

All 19 relevant tests pass when run together.

Updated `atomic_move()` to give newly created files a `0600` default, adjusted for the current umask. Modules that accept `mode` now warn for each created path when it is omitted; a later `set_mode_if_different()` call removes that path from warning tracking. Existing destination modes remain preserved.

The 47 targeted tests pass, and `git diff --check` is clean. The broader `module_utils/basic` run has unrelated failures from accumulated global warning state; a deprecation warning failure reproduced without the new atomic move tests.

Updated the repository to require Python 3.12 or newer on the controller. Both user-facing entry points now show the same version error; packaging metadata and the changelog reflect the change. Python 3.10 and 3.11 remain listed for managed targets.

Collection installation no longer uses the private TarFile cache. `_extract_tar_dir` passes `dirname` unchanged to `getmember()` and raises the specified `AnsibleError` when the member is missing. I also removed controller compatibility branches made obsolete by the new minimum.

Verification: 159 relevant unit tests passed and 1 was skipped. Both entry points rejected Python 3.11 with identical messages. The test runner has only Python 3.11, so the unit tests ran with the import gate bypassed in memory; they were not run under Python 3.12.

Updated anonymous telemetry to version `1.3`. When audit sinks are enabled, the payload includes `audit.sinks` with `log`, `webhook`, or both; when neither is enabled, it omits `audit`.

Added coverage for all sink combinations in [telemetry_test.go](/app/internal/telemetry/telemetry_test.go). `go test ./internal/telemetry` and `git diff --check` passed.

Fixed `BatchEvaluate` so disabled flags produce an entry in input order with `match: false`, an empty value, a timestamp, and their own request duration. Other evaluation errors still abort the batch, and the outer response retains the total duration.

Added `ErrDisabled` and `ErrDisabledf`, migrated timestamp and empty-result types to `timestamppb` and `emptypb`, and kept the grpc-gateway v1 legacy proto import required by its forwarding API.

Verification: `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test -mod=mod ./...` passed.

Added `LogConfig.GRPCLevel` with an `ERROR` default. `Load(path)` now reads `log.grpc_level` independently of the existing logging fields. The default config example and tests were updated.

Verified with `go test ./config` and `git diff --check`; both passed.

Updated `listRemoveAll` in the Redis, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL backends to remove every requested string while preserving the order of the remaining list. Added a regression test that reads the list immediately after removal.

The Redis list suite passes (20 tests), and lint passes. MongoDB and PostgreSQL integration tests could not run because those services were unavailable.

Added the Linux `locally_reachable_ips` fact in [linux.py](/app/lib/ansible/module_utils/facts/network/linux.py). It provides normalized, deduplicated, consistently ordered `ipv4` and `ipv6` lists from local routes. Failed route queries produce an empty list and a warning without preventing other network facts from being gathered.

Added [unit tests](/app/test/units/module_utils/facts/network/test_linux.py). All 10 network unit tests pass; `git diff --check` passes.

Updated [redhatbase.go](/app/scanner/redhatbase.go) to preserve empty release fields in RPM and repoquery output, format source package versions without a trailing hyphen, parse `-src.rpm` filenames, and reject malformed filenames. Update candidates now treat `(none)` as an absent epoch.

Added regression cases in [redhatbase_test.go](/app/scanner/redhatbase_test.go). The focused scanner tests and `git diff --check` pass.

Added `Metadata.CheckForUpdates` to the configuration. It defaults to `true` and can be set with `metadata.check_for_updates` in YAML or JSON. Updated the default configuration example and added loading tests for both formats.

`go test ./config` and `go test ./cmd/flipt ./config` pass.

`getOpenSubsonicExtensions` is now registered outside the authentication middleware in [api.go](/app/server/subsonic/api.go). Unauthenticated requests with `?f=json` return JSON containing exactly `transcodeOffset`, `formPost`, and `songLyrics`.

Route tests cover both URL forms and confirm a protected endpoint still requires parameters. `go test ./server/subsonic` passed.

Updated the WordPress cache lookup to use a map directly and return `("", false)` for missing or nil entries. The scan now reads `IgnoreInactive` from its server configuration and excludes plugins and themes whose `Status` is `"inactive"` while retaining active packages.

Added tests for cache entries and both server settings. `go test ./wordpress ./report ./models` and `git diff --check` passed.

Updated optimistic mark-as handling so elements are added to `bypassFilter` only when their new status needs to bypass the active filter, and stale IDs are removed when it does not.

The change passes `markAsStatus` through the dispatch, adds the filter decision helper, and covers both message and conversation IDs with tests. Verification passed: 13 tests across three Jest suites, the mail TypeScript check, and Prettier.

Added `SimpleCache[V]` in [simple_cache.go](/app/utils/cache/simple_cache.go) with typed add, TTL, get, loader, and active-key operations. Migrated the HTTP client, genre repository, and play tracker to use it, removing their direct `ttlcache` use and retrieval type assertions. The HTTP cache retains its 100-entry limit.

Added cache behavior tests. `go test ./utils/cache ./scanner ./core/scrobbler` passes.

Added a **Polls history** button to [RoomSummaryCard](/app/src/components/views/right_panel/RoomSummaryCard.tsx). It appears only when the new `feature_poll_history` Labs setting is enabled and opens the named [PollHistoryDialog](/app/src/components/views/dialogs/polls/PollHistoryDialog.tsx) with the current `roomId`.

The relevant existing tests passed (7 tests), as did ESLint. The full TypeScript check remains blocked by an unrelated error in `RoomCreate.tsx`: `RoomState` lacks `findPredecessor`.

Added the download mechanism metric to the existing metrics infrastructure. [useDownloadMetrics](/app/applications/drive/src/app/store/_downloads/DownloadProvider/useDownloadMetrics.ts) now records terminal outcomes with `status`, `retry`, and `mechanism` labels for stateful downloads and previews. The [file saver](/app/applications/drive/src/app/store/_downloads/fileSaver/fileSaver.ts) exposes `selectMechanismForDownload(size)`, and the new [schema](/app/packages/metrics/types/web_drive_download_mechanism_success_rate_total_v1.schema.d.ts) defines the allowed labels.

Verification: 20 focused tests passed, and `git diff --check` passed.

Amazon Linux 2023 now parses from `/etc/system-release`, and ALAS2023 advisories get the corresponding source links. Version normalization and EOL mappings cover 2023, 2025, 2027, and 2029; unrecognized releases remain unfound. I added tests for version handling and EOL boundaries.

`go test ./config ./scanner ./oval` passed with dependency downloads disabled.

Fortinet advisories now participate in FortiOS CVE detection and enrichment. Results include advisory IDs and URLs, CVSS v3 data, CWE IDs, references, and dates; confidence and report ordering also account for Fortinet. The repository now uses a Fortinet-capable `go-cve-dictionary` version.

The models and detector tests pass; the server package builds. Tests used a temporary offline module substitution for one uncached transitive dependency. The checked-out [go.mod](/app/go.mod) contains no substitution.

Added `route_targets` to [nxos_vrf_af.py](/app/lib/ansible/modules/network/nxos/nxos_vrf_af.py). It supports multiple import and export values, defaults `direction: both` to both directions, and applies mixed present and absent entries within the specified VRF address family. The new `match_current_rt` helper generates commands only when the current configuration differs.

Added focused tests in [test_nxos_vrf_af.py](/app/test/units/modules/network/nxos/test_nxos_vrf_af.py). All 10 tests pass, and `git diff --check` passes.

Artist artwork now checks for `artist.*` in the folder derived from the artist’s albums before using external files, URLs, or a placeholder. Albums persist their unique media directories, local image changes update the artwork cache key, and each lookup attempt logs its duration. The database migration triggers a full rescan to populate directories for existing albums.

Relevant tests passed: `go test ./model ./core/artwork ./db ./persistence ./scanner`.

MARC imports now map supported `$e` terms and `$4` codes to readable contributor roles, with `$4` taking precedence. New work entries preserve each role beside the correct author and raise an exception when edition and record author counts differ.

Updated the MARC fixtures and added parser, work, and import tests. **Verification:** 164 relevant tests passed; Ruff and `git diff --check` passed.

Added the global `chat:privileged` permission and enforced it when starting a chat or inviting a privileged user. Denied attempts return `[[error:no-privileges]]`. Chat middleware and messaging now use array based privilege checks, and user profile responses include a boolean `canChat` field documented in OpenAPI. The privilege also has an admin UI label.

Verification passed: 79 messaging tests, 273 user tests, ESLint, and `git diff --check`.

Implemented the QtWebEngine 5.15.3 locale workaround. The new `qt.workarounds.locale` setting defaults to `false` and is available only with the QtWebEngine backend. When enabled on Linux, qutebrowser checks for the locale’s `.pak` file and adds `--lang` with a Chromium-compatible fallback only when that file is missing.

Added coverage for locale mappings, missing packs, the version and platform gates, and argument generation. The relevant tests passed: **182 passed**.

Updated the pip module to use `sys.executable -m pip` when pip is available to the current interpreter. Launcher commands now use argv lists, package listing tries `list --format=freeze` before `freeze`, and virtualenv path construction uses `os.path.join`.

The pip unit tests pass: **9 passed**. `git diff --check` also passed.

Refactored [Pill](/app/src/components/views/elements/Pill.tsx) into a functional component and moved permalink resolution into the public [usePermalink hook](/app/src/hooks/usePermalink.tsx). Pill and its `@room` helpers are now named exports, and pillify, ReplyChain, and BridgeTile use named imports.

The relevant existing tests passed: **5 tests across 2 suites**. ESLint and `git diff --check` passed. TypeScript still reports SDK compatibility errors outside the changed files; it reported none in the changed files.

Updated coverstore archival to use zero-padded ZIP batches, verified uploads, batch locks, and database URLs after finalization. The hardcoded 8M tar redirect is removed, and the path schema is documented in [README.md](/app/openlibrary/coverstore/README.md).

Coverstore tests: **21 passed, 7 skipped**. Ruff and `git diff --check` passed. Existing databases need the new `failed` and `uploaded` columns and indexes before running this version.

Added `flipt.is_auth_method(input, method)` to the Rego authorization engines. It accepts the seven specified labels, maps them to the `auth.proto` method codes, and treats `k8s` and `kubernetes` as aliases. It returns false for a nonmatching method and the specified errors for missing authentication or an unsupported label.

Tests cover every label, false results, both errors, and policy registration. The relevant engine tests pass.

Added `storage.readOnly` to backend configuration and frontend types. Validation now rejects an explicitly set value on non-database storage, including `false`, with the required error message. The UI selector uses the flag when present and defaults to read-only for non-database storage; the header’s “Read-Only” badge now shows the active backend’s icon. Authentication bootstrap also skips database access when authentication is disabled and storage is not database-backed. The requested fixture is included.

`go test ./internal/config ./internal/cmd ./config` and `git diff --check` passed. UI tests could not run because the repository’s UI dependencies are absent.

Updated notifications to render sanitized HTML, make links open with `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"`, and deduplicate non-success messages by their explicit key or the required fallback. Repeated success notifications remain visible.

Added [notification tests](/app/packages/components/containers/notifications/notifications.test.tsx). All 6 pass; the component type check, lint, and `git diff --check` also pass.

Implemented DynamoDB `billing_mode`. New tables default to `pay_per_request`, which omits provisioned throughput and ignores capacity unit settings and auto scaling. `provisioned` uses the configured capacity units and permits auto scaling. Initialization now checks an existing table’s billing mode and logs when it ignores auto scaling for an on-demand table.

Updated the [backend documentation](/app/lib/backend/dynamo/README.md) and added [billing mode tests](/app/lib/backend/dynamo/billing_mode_test.go). The package tests and focused DynamoDB tagged tests pass. The AWS integration tests were not run.

Implemented topic backlinks. Posts now synchronize references on creation and edit, remove events for links that are edited out, and show localized “Referenced by” timeline links when the new admin setting is enabled.

Verification: 196 topic tests passed, including the new backlink tests. ESLint, JSON parsing, and diff checks passed.

Resolved the assistant HTML and Markdown issue. The composer’s message ID now flows through model preparation, result rendering, and editor insertion. URL placeholders restore links and images only for that message; unknown or cross-message links lose their URL while keeping visible text. Conversion also preserves `class` and `style` on links and images and repairs nested lists before Markdown conversion.

All 20 relevant tests passed, and lint passed. The app type check remains blocked by an unrelated OpenPGP type conflict in `packages/crypto/lib/worker/api.ts`; it reported no errors in the changed files.

stages.handoff:
Added ipset support to the [iptables module](/app/lib/ansible/modules/iptables.py). `match_set` and `match_set_flags` now produce `-m set --match-set <setname> <flags>`, whether or not `match: ['set']` is supplied. The parameters are required together, flags are limited to the four requested values, and a leading `!` inverts the set match.

[Unit tests](/app/test/units/modules/test_iptables.py) cover rule construction, inversion, and invalid inputs. All 26 iptables tests pass; `git diff --check` also passes.

Added a kebab menu to the **Current session** header with localized, destructive “Sign out” and “Sign out all other sessions” actions. The trigger exposes its disabled and expanded states, supports keyboard use, and closes the menu after an action. The bulk action passes only other device IDs.

The relevant device, session, and context-menu suites pass: **100 tests**. Focused lint passes. The repository-wide TypeScript check still fails on existing `matrix-js-sdk` type errors outside the changed files.

Fixed the device-limit enrollment path. The fake service can now simulate the limit and returns an `AccessDenied` error. `RunAdmin` preserves the registered device and reports `DeviceRegistered` when enrollment fails, and `printEnrollOutcome` handles a nil device without panicking. Added a regression test confirming that registration persists and the error contains “device limit.”

The focused enrollment tests pass. The `tsh` package compile could not complete because this environment lacks `linux/hidraw.h` and `gnu/libc-version.h`.

Added bounded event polling after the PayPal payment method flow. The hook now exports `interval = 5000` and `maxPollingSteps = 5`, can stop early on a matching `PaymentMethods` create event, and unsubscribes when polling finishes.

All five focused tests pass. The components type check, Prettier check, and `git diff --check` also pass.

Added a configurable, comma-separated `systemTags` setting in [Tag Settings](/app/src/views/admin/settings/tags.tpl). Topic creation, editing, and queue validation now reject reserved tags for users who are not privileged with the message “You can not use this system tag.” The `isTagAllowed` check also returns false for reserved tags.

The focused topic privilege and category whitelist tests passed (10 tests), and ESLint passed. A broader filtered run stopped in a tag-search test whose prerequisite tests were excluded by the filter.

Updated the OSS v6 migration to downgrade the existing `admin` role in place and mark it with `OSSMigratedV6`. Existing users, trusted cluster mappings, and legacy user creation now use `admin`, preserving the role name needed for leaf cluster access. The downgraded role allows read-only events and sessions, and a repeat migration skips an already labeled role.

The focused migration test passed. The services and `tctl` packages compiled, and `git diff --check` passed.

Added `id_project_runeberg` to every work search response as a list, using `[]` when absent. Existing identifier fields remain unchanged. I also registered `ProjectRunebergProvider` and added its [read button](/app/openlibrary/templates/book_providers/runeberg_read_button.html) and [download options](/app/openlibrary/templates/book_providers/runeberg_download_options.html) templates.

All 5 relevant tests pass; both templates compile. Format options link to the Runeberg edition page because the repository does not document verified format specific download URLs.

Updated [mathstuff.py](/app/lib/ansible/plugins/filter/mathstuff.py) so `min` and `max` forward all keyword arguments to Jinja2’s enhanced filters when available. When either enhanced filter is unavailable, calls without keywords use Python’s built-in function; calls with keywords raise the specified `AnsibleFilterError`.

Updated the [filter tests](/app/test/units/plugins/filter/test_mathstuff.py). All 57 tests pass.

Updated the certificate wrappers. WebKit now accepts named `reply` and `errors` arguments while preserving existing positional error calls; construction leaves the reply untouched. Single errors render as escaped paragraphs, and multiple errors as escaped lists. The shared decision API now supports acceptance, rejection, and deferral, with Qt 5 and Qt 6 WebEngine wrappers selected through a factory.

The focused tests pass (10/10), and `git diff --check` passes. All 25 WebEngine tab tests reported passing, but that test process exited with an X11 disconnect during teardown.

Added tracing configuration for a sampling ratio and the eight supported propagators, with defaults and exact validation errors. The tracer provider now uses the configured ratio, and gRPC uses the configured propagators. The configuration schemas and focused tests were updated.

Validation passed: `go test ./internal/config ./config ./internal/tracing ./internal/cmd` with network access disabled, and `git diff --check`.

OCI bundle manifests now use `storage.oci.manifest_version`. The accepted values are `"1.0"` and `"1.1"`; omitted values default to `"1.1"`, and unsupported values return the requested validation error. Bundle creation uses the new `WithManifestVersion` option.

Configuration and generated manifest tests pass, along with `go test ./internal/config ./internal/oci ./internal/storage/fs/store ./internal/storage/fs/oci`.

Updated promise imports to stage and augment incomplete records using ISBN-10 first, then a `B*` ASIN. The import API now fills missing fields from staged metadata before validation, while preserving non-empty fields. Validation accepts either complete metadata or a title, source record, and strong identifier. The batch script also records total and incomplete gauges and continues after staging lookup failures.

**Verification:** 112 relevant tests passed; Ruff lint and `git diff --check` passed.

Updated host blocking so a blocked domain also blocks its subdomains. The blocker checks the per-URL toggle and whitelist first, then checks each parent hostname against both block sets. Trailing dots are normalized for matching, and `urlutils.widened_hostnames` provides the requested hostname sequence.

Relevant tests passed: **357 passed, 1 skipped**.

Added `-wp-ignore-inactive` to the report, server, and TUI commands, plus `wpIgnoreInactive` in the config schema. When enabled, WordPress vulnerability lookups skip inactive plugins and themes. The new `removeInactives` helper returns `nil` when every package is inactive.

Focused tests were added, and `go test -p 1 ./config ./wordpress ./commands ./report` passed with network access disabled.

Implemented a typed expression AST with nested evaluation, strict variable and function validation, and a shared regex pipeline for interpolation and matching. Updated trait and PAM interpolation to validate variables inside nested expressions.

`go test ./lib/utils/parse` passes, and `git diff --check` is clean. The broader `lib/services` and `lib/srv` tests could not compile in this environment because `linux/hidraw.h` is missing; disabling CGO exposed unrelated BPF and U2F build errors.

Author identifiers are now generated by the shared `add_db_name` function in [catalog utils](/app/openlibrary/catalog/utils/__init__.py) whenever an edition is expanded. Existing editions pass their author names and birth/death dates into that expansion, and the comparator recognizes names written in either “Given Family” or “Family, Given” order.

The relevant catalog tests passed: **72 passed, 1 expected failure, 2 unexpected passes**. `git diff --check` also passed. Ruff reported a pre-existing duplicate import in `test_add_book.py`.

Moved edition expansion to `expand_record()` in [catalog.utils](/app/openlibrary/catalog/utils/__init__.py), alongside its title expansion helper. Updated the add book callers and tests, and removed `build_marc()` from `merge_marc.py`.

Verification: the broader catalog suite had 84 passed, 8 skipped, and 2 expected failures. Focused tests, Ruff, and `git diff --check` also passed.

Updated both copies of the photo recovery hook to load regular and trashed items together, wait for both to finish decrypting, and include trashed photo entries in the recovery count. Recovery now fails if loading, moving, or deleting fails, or if targeted photos remain; persisted in-progress recovery still resumes on initialization.

Both mirrored test suites pass (10 tests each), and targeted lint passes. The full type check remains blocked by an unrelated OpenPGP type mismatch in `crypto/lib/worker/api.ts`.

Updated [linux.py](/app/lib/ansible/module_utils/facts/hardware/linux.py) to read IBM Z identity fields from `/proc/sysinfo` and include them in gathered hardware facts. When the file is absent, `get_sysinfo_facts()` returns `{}`; when present, it returns the five required keys, using `NA` for missing values and removing leading zeros from the serial.

Added coverage in [test_linux.py](/app/test/units/module_utils/facts/hardware/test_linux.py). The hardware fact unit suite passed: **21 tests**.

Updated [DeviceConfig.ts](/app/src/misc/DeviceConfig.ts) so loading an existing config preserves its settings and makes no storage write when the version and signup token are already present. Migration converts credential arrays to a userId-keyed object; credentials remain a Map in memory and are persisted with the required underscored keys. Initialization also recovers from invalid or unavailable storage.

Added coverage in [DeviceConfigTest.ts](/app/test/client/misc/DeviceConfigTest.ts). Type checks passed, and the client suite passed all 3,077 assertions.

Updated the SSH multiplexer to recognize `Teleport-Proxy` JSON headers terminated by a null byte, route those connections as SSH, and expose `ClientAddr` through `RemoteAddr()`. Standard SSH behavior remains unchanged.

Added connection tests. `go test ./lib/multiplexer -count=1` passes.

Updated the QtWebEngine argument builder to merge all enabled features into one `--enable-features=` flag and pass each `--disable-features=` flag through unchanged. Both command-line and configuration flags are covered, including comma-separated lists.

The focused test suite passed: 90 tests. `git diff --check` passed. Flake8 was unavailable in the environment.

Updated collection builds to distinguish an absent `manifest` with `Sentinel`. Explicit `manifest: {}` and `manifest: null` now select the default manifest directives, while absent manifests still apply `build_ignore`. The file walk also excludes symlinks that point outside the collection and retains internal links under their linked path once. Documentation and tests were updated.

Verification: 68 collection tests and 56 collection install tests passed. The local environment lacks `distlib`, so the explicit manifest route was verified with a mock rather than an end-to-end build.

Updated the Qt WebEngine file picker in [webview.py](/app/qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webview.py) to add missing filename extensions for accepted MIME types on Qt 6.2.3 through 6.6.x. The change covers specific MIME types and wildcards such as `image/*`, and avoids adding extensions already present.

Added unit coverage in [test_webview.py](/app/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py). All 14 tests pass; `git diff --check` passes.

Added [icx_logging.py](/app/lib/ansible/modules/network/icx/icx_logging.py) with ICX commands for IPv4 and IPv6 syslog hosts, UDP ports, facilities, console and global logging, buffered levels, persistence, and RFC5424. It supports aggregate settings, present and absent states, running configuration comparison, and check mode.

Added [unit tests](/app/test/units/modules/network/icx/test_icx_logging.py). The full ICX unit suite passes: **101 tests**.

Fixed the member view in both Drive copies. Members, internal invitations, and external invitations are now stored and selected by `shareId`, so changes to one share do not affect another. Added `getExistingEmails` and tests for share isolation.

Verification passed: both workspace type checks, 21 application tests, the focused tests in both copies, and `git diff --check`. ESLint reported no errors.

Updated Windows SSH stderr handling to replace embedded, valid CLIXML with readable bytes while preserving surrounding text and incomplete or invalid blocks. The decoder uses UTF-8 with a cp437 fallback, and the UTF-16-BE escape pattern now leaves unrelated Unicode sequences intact.

The relevant PowerShell and SSH tests pass: **49 passed**.

Added digest support across image configuration, scanning, scan results, logging, and report identifiers. Image validation now requires a name and exactly one of tag or digest; `GetFullName()` produces the corresponding full reference. Per-image server names now use `<index>@<originalServerName>`.

Config, scan, and report tests passed with vet disabled, and the targeted models tests passed. The full models suite still fails in the existing `TestScan` (“no vuln found”); default vet also reports existing errors in `models/library.go`.

Implemented predictable `no_log` sanitization. `remove_values` now masks sensitive substrings in string values while leaving keys and non-string scalars unchanged. The new `sanitize_keys` masks matching keys throughout nested containers, preserves ignored and `_ansible` keys, and uses the required sentinel for exact matches. The `uri` module applies it when `no_log_values` is populated, with `NO_MODIFY_KEYS`.
