Fixed the album grid shaking caused by non-square covers. The grid now requests square artwork; the backend centers each cover on a square PNG canvas and uses a separate cache key for that version. Regular artwork requests retain their existing shape and format.

The artwork, Subsonic, and public server tests pass. UI lint and formatting checks pass.

I did not add the requested OCI `Source` interface: this checkout has no `internal/storage/fs/oci` package or the related OCI types, and that interface is unrelated to the album issue.

Fixed the OIDC login flow. Authentication validation now stores only the hostname in `Session.Domain`; OIDC state and token cookies omit the `Domain` attribute for localhost; and callback URLs remove one trailing host slash before adding the callback path. Added regression tests for these cases.

The config and OIDC package tests pass, and `git diff --check` is clean.

Fixed the auth service crash for multiple audit event backends. `MultiLog` now validates that each backend can emit events and fans events out to them. The `stdout://` backend now uses `WriterEmitter`, which writes newline-delimited JSON audit events. Close errors are aggregated.

The focused `lib/events` tests and the service configuration test, including a combined `file://` and `stdout://` configuration, pass.

Refactored the Drive extended-attribute service to use `XAttrCreateParams` for file creation and encryption, added `DeepPartial` and explicit public types, and made parsing return a neutral structure for malformed or partial input. Creation now omits a zero remainder block and omits `Digests` when none are supplied. The upload caller and tests use the new parameter shape; the old service import path remains available through a re-export.

Verification passed: 5 focused Jest tests, the Drive TypeScript check, ESLint, Prettier, and `git diff --check`.

Added [removeTechnicalFields](/app/src/api/common/utils/EntityUtils.ts:138). It mutates a new entity to remove keys beginning with `_finalEncrypted`, `_defaultEncrypted`, or `_errors` at the root and throughout nested objects and arrays. Entities without those fields remain unchanged. Added [regression tests](/app/test/tests/api/common/utils/EntityUtilsTest.ts:42) for both cases.

Verification passed: TypeScript, Prettier, ESLint, and the existing test suite (8,690 assertions).

Diff reports now mark newly detected CVEs with `+` and resolved CVEs with `-`. The diff function accepts plus/minus booleans, excludes unchanged CVEs, and uses package data from the scan where each reported CVE appeared. Report and TUI users can select either type with `-diff-plus=false` or `-diff-minus=false`; both are shown by default. The requested formatting, counting, and status interfaces are also in place.

Verified with `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./models ./report ./subcmds` and `git diff --check`.

Added `destination_ports` to the [iptables module](/app/lib/ansible/modules/iptables.py). It accepts a list of ports or ranges, defaults to an empty list, and builds a single `-m multiport --dports` rule. Nonempty lists are restricted to tcp, udp, udplite, dccp, and sctp. Documentation and unit tests were updated.

Verification: all 23 [iptables unit tests](/app/test/units/modules/test_iptables.py) pass; `git diff --check` passes.

Implemented opt-out anonymous telemetry in [telemetry.go](/app/telemetry/telemetry.go) and connected it to server startup. It stores a random host UUID in `telemetry.json`, sends `flipt.ping` every four hours, and updates the timestamp only after an accepted response. [Config](/app/config/config.go) now supports both requested environment variables; the advanced example disables telemetry. I also moved the `/meta/info` handler to [internal/info/flipt.go](/app/internal/info/flipt.go).

`go test ./...`, focused race tests, and `git diff --check` pass. Live delivery to the telemetry endpoint remains unverified.

Updated `getObject` and `getObjects` across MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Redis to accept optional field names. An empty or omitted `fields` array returns the full object, including through `getObjectFields` and `getObjectsFields`. Selected fields include `null` for absent fields; object reads return `null` for missing keys, and bulk reads preserve input order.

Added coverage in [hash.js](/app/test/database/hash.js). The Redis hash suite passed **60 tests**, and ESLint and `git diff --check` passed. MongoDB and PostgreSQL integration tests were not run because those services were unavailable.

Resolved the validation gap. `Validate` now returns a single error that unwraps into individual messages with file, line, and column locations. It detects unknown variants and segments, including references from boolean flags. Snapshot creation validates each file, and `flipt import` checks references before making changes, so repeated attempts report the same error.

The valid fixtures were corrected, and regression tests cover reference errors and repeated imports. The relevant Go tests and `git diff --check` pass.

Fixed `/lists/add` form parsing. When a request has a body, [ListRecord.from_input](/app/openlibrary/plugins/openlibrary/lists.py:52) uses the first value for each URL-encoded field and keeps query parameters out of the list data. Nested seed fields no longer conflict with defaults; invalid seeds are ignored. [Unflattening](/app/openlibrary/plugins/upstream/utils.py:269) now lets later assignments win.

Verification: 18 relevant tests passed; Ruff and `git diff --check` passed.

Added `isoneof` and `isnotoneof` for string and number constraints. Create and update requests now validate JSON array types and enforce the 100-item limit. I added focused tests for matching, invalid values, and the limit boundary.

The `rpc/flipt` and legacy evaluator test suites passed.

Implemented `ansible-galaxy collection install -U/--upgrade`. It selects the latest version allowed by each constraint, updates dependencies when their installed versions no longer qualify, honors `--no-deps` and `--pre`, and skips reinstalling a version that is already installed. The same behavior applies to requirements files.

Added unit coverage and the requested [upgrade.yml](/app/test/integration/targets/ansible-galaxy-collection/tasks/upgrade.yml). All 154 Galaxy unit tests passed; the integration YAML parses successfully. The integration scenario was not run because it requires the Pulp test services.

Popper now reports RTL aware placement values: `top` and `bottom` swap `start` and `end` in RTL, while left, right, and all LTR placements stay unchanged. The new helper and Floating UI middleware are wired into `usePopper`’s reported placement in [usePopper.ts](/app/packages/components/components/popper/usePopper.ts) and exported from the Popper module.

Verification passed: 33 Popper tests, the component TypeScript check, ESLint, and Prettier.

Updated Touch ID support with a public `DiagResult` and `Diag()` API, macOS availability checks, and a fix for selecting the allowed credential when several are present. The expanded WebAuthn test covers both passwordless login and login with multiple credentials.

The Touch ID and WebAuthn test suites pass, and `git diff --check` is clean. The native macOS checks could not be exercised in this Linux workspace.

Added the module-level [make_date_string](/app/openlibrary/plugins/upstream/checkins.py:17) function and a patron check-ins update handler that rejects requests without an event ID or updatable content and checks event ownership. I also fixed the event data update method so the handler can call it.

Verification: 20 relevant tests passed; `git diff --check` passed.

Fixed `atomic_move()` so newly created files receive `0600` under umask `0022`. Modules that accept `mode` now emit the specified warning for each new path when `mode` is omitted; a later `set_mode_if_different()` call removes that path from warning tracking.

Updated the relevant tests. The `module_utils/basic` suite passed: **299 passed, 14 skipped**.

Updated the repository to require Python 3.12 or newer on the controller. The CLI and `ansible-test` now show the same version error, while Python 3.10 and 3.11 remain supported for managed nodes. Collection extraction now calls `tar.getmember(dirname)` unchanged, raises the required error for a missing member, and no longer uses `_ansible_normalized_cache`. I also simplified obsolete controller compatibility code and added a [breaking-change fragment](/app/changelogs/fragments/controller-python-3.12.yml).

Verification: 94 focused tests passed, 1 skipped; syntax checks and `git diff --check` passed. Python 3.12 is unavailable locally, so the full controller test suite could not be run under the new minimum.

Updated anonymous telemetry to version `1.3`. The payload now includes `flipt.audit.sinks` with `"log"` and/or `"webhook"` when those sinks are enabled, and omits `audit` when neither is enabled. Existing telemetry fields retain their structure and behavior.

Added tests for all four sink combinations. `go test ./internal/telemetry` passed, and `git diff --check` found no whitespace issues.

Fixed `BatchEvaluate` so disabled flags no longer abort the batch. It returns one response per input, in order; disabled entries have `match: false` and `value: "disabled"`. Every entry has a timestamp and its own duration, and the outer response has the total duration.

Added the typed `ErrDisabled` error and migrated the protobuf timestamp and empty response types. The full test suite passes offline with `go test ./...`.

Added `LogConfig.GRPCLevel` with an `ERROR` default. `Load(path)` now reads `log.grpc_level` independently of the existing logging settings. Updated the config example and tests.

Verification passed: `go test ./config ./cmd/flipt`.

Updated list removal in Redis, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL to accept multiple distinct strings in one call. The added test confirms that requested values are removed, the remaining order is preserved, and a read immediately after completion returns the updated list.

Verification: all 20 list tests passed against Redis; lint and `git diff --check` passed. MongoDB and PostgreSQL integration tests were not run.

Added the Linux `locally_reachable_ips` fact with separate `ipv4` and `ipv6` lists. It reads local routes, normalizes and deduplicates addresses and prefixes, and orders them consistently. When route data is unavailable, it returns empty lists with a warning.

Added [unit tests](/app/test/units/module_utils/facts/network/test_linux_locally_reachable_ips.py) and a changelog entry. The relevant tests passed: **146 passed, 5 skipped**.

Fixed the RPM parsers in [redhatbase.go](/app/scanner/redhatbase.go). They now preserve empty release fields in `rpm -qa` and repoquery output, format source versions without a trailing hyphen when release is empty, and parse the reported `-src.rpm` filename forms while rejecting malformed filenames. Update candidates use the same epoch rule.

Added regression cases in [redhatbase_test.go](/app/scanner/redhatbase_test.go). The targeted scanner tests and `git diff --check` pass.

Added `Config.Metadata.CheckForUpdates`, defaulting to `true`. The loader now accepts `metadata.check_for_updates` in YAML and JSON; the sample config and tests cover the setting.

Verified with `go test ./config ./cmd/flipt` and `git diff --check`.

Moved `getOpenSubsonicExtensions` outside the authentication and required-parameter middleware in [api.go](/app/server/subsonic/api.go:69). Its `?f=json` response remains available without credentials and contains exactly `transcodeOffset`, `formPost`, and `songLyrics`.

Added route tests in [api_test.go](/app/server/subsonic/api_test.go:114). The Subsonic and response test suites pass.

Updated the WordPress cache lookup to use the map directly and treat a nil entry as a miss. The scan now reads the target server’s ignore inactive setting and excludes plugins and themes whose `Status` is `"inactive"` while keeping active packages.

Added regression coverage in [wordpress_test.go](/app/wordpress/wordpress_test.go). The relevant tests passed offline: `go test ./wordpress ./report ./models`.

Fixed stale bypass entries in the mail view. The mark-as action now carries its status, and the reducer adds an element’s ID to `bypassFilter` only when its new status conflicts with the active read or unread filter. When the status matches the filter, it removes the ID. The logic is in [elementsReducers.ts](/app/applications/mail/src/app/logic/elements/elementsReducers.ts) and the new [elementBypassFilters.ts](/app/applications/mail/src/app/logic/elements/helpers/elementBypassFilters.ts).

Verification passed: 8 relevant Jest tests, the TypeScript check, Prettier, and `git diff --check`.

Added [SimpleCache[V]](/app/utils/cache/simple_cache.go) and migrated the play tracker, genre repository, and HTTP client to use it. Cached values are now typed at the call sites, TTLs do not extend on reads, and the HTTP client retains its 100-entry limit.

The cache, scanner, and scrobbler tests pass: `go test ./utils/cache ./scanner ./core/scrobbler`.

Added a **Polls history** button to `RoomSummaryCard`. It appears only when the new `feature_poll_history` Messaging lab setting is enabled and opens the named [PollHistoryDialog](/app/src/components/views/dialogs/polls/PollHistoryDialog.tsx) with the current room’s `roomId`.

The relevant Jest suites passed (7 tests), along with ESLint, Prettier, and Stylelint. Full TypeScript checking remains blocked by an error in untouched [RoomCreate.tsx](/app/src/components/views/messages/RoomCreate.tsx:50): `RoomState` lacks `findPredecessor`.

Added the mechanism-segmented download counter and registered it with the metrics backend. [useDownloadMetrics.ts](/app/applications/drive/src/app/store/_downloads/DownloadProvider/useDownloadMetrics.ts) now records terminal outcomes with status, retry, and mechanism labels. The file saver exposes `selectMechanismForDownload`, and preview downloads pass their size into reporting.

Verification passed: 21 focused tests, Drive and metrics type checks, ESLint, and `git diff --check`.

Amazon Linux 2023 is now detected correctly, and OVAL looks up its release instead of falling back to Amazon Linux 1. The change also adds ALAS2023 advisory links and EOL mappings for 2023, 2025, 2027, and 2029.

The focused config, scanner, and OVAL tests pass with module downloads disabled.

Fortinet advisories now participate in FortiOS CPE detection and CVE enrichment. Results include advisory IDs and URLs, CVSS v3 data, CWE IDs, references, and dates. Confidence ranking and report selection order include Fortinet, and the dictionary dependency has been updated.

The existing detector and model tests, new Fortinet regression tests, and the server build pass with `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./detector ./models ./server`. The module file includes a cached-version replacement for an unrelated transitive dependency to support offline builds.

Added `route_targets` support to [nxos_vrf_af.py](/app/lib/ansible/modules/network/nxos/nxos_vrf_af.py). Each entry can add or remove an import, export, or both route-targets. Command generation is scoped to the requested VRF and address family and is idempotent.

Added focused coverage in [test_nxos_vrf_af.py](/app/test/units/modules/network/nxos/test_nxos_vrf_af.py). All 19 relevant unit tests passed, and `git diff --check` passed.

Artist artwork now checks for `artist.*` in the folder derived from its albums’ media directories before trying external files, URLs, or a placeholder. Albums persist their unique media directories, and every artwork source attempt records its duration in trace logs. The migration triggers a full rescan to populate directories for existing albums.

Tests passed: `go test ./core/artwork ./model ./scanner ./persistence ./db`.

Expanded MARC contributor role support in [parse.py](/app/openlibrary/catalog/marc/parse.py): `ROLES` maps relator codes and common abbreviations to readable names. `read_author_person` reads `$e` and `$4`, gives `$4` precedence, and omits unrecognized roles.

Work author links now preserve roles in order and raise an exception when edition and record author counts differ. Updated MARC fixtures and added tests for parsing, precedence, ordering, and import.

**Verified:** 293 relevant tests passed; Ruff and `git diff --check` passed.

Implemented the `chat:privileged` gate. Direct chats and invitations to privileged users now return `[[error:no-privileges]]` unless the initiator has that permission. Chat checks use the new array-capable `privileges.global.can`, and profile APIs expose a boolean `canChat` field documented in OpenAPI.

Added the admin privilege label and regression tests. The messaging suite passed (80 tests), the middleware suite passed (12 tests), and the user tests passed in the combined run. ESLint and `git diff --check` passed.

Implemented the QtWebEngine 5.15.3 locale workaround in [qtargs.py](/app/qutebrowser/config/qtargs.py). When enabled on Linux, it checks for the locale’s `.pak` file and adds a Chromium-compatible `--lang` fallback if needed. The new [qt.workarounds.locale setting](/app/qutebrowser/config/configdata.yml) is available only for QtWebEngine and defaults to `false`.

Verification: 192 targeted tests passed. `git diff --check` and Python compilation passed. Flake8 was unavailable locally.

Fixed the pip module so that, when no `executable` or `virtualenv` is set, it uses the current interpreter’s `python -m pip` if the pip library is available. The launcher is now an argv list throughout; package listing tries `list --format=freeze` before `freeze` and returns a command string for logging. Virtualenv path setup now uses `os.path.join`.

Updated [pip.py](/app/lib/ansible/modules/pip.py) and its [unit tests](/app/test/units/modules/test_pip.py). All 12 pip unit tests pass, and `git diff --check` is clean.

Refactored [Pill.tsx](/app/src/components/views/elements/Pill.tsx) into a functional component and added the public [usePermalink hook](/app/src/hooks/usePermalink.tsx). The module now exposes named `Pill`, `PillType`, and `@room` helper exports; its callers use named imports. The rendering rules, original message URL, avatars, tooltips, and user click action are covered by tests.

Both relevant Jest suites pass (7 tests), and ESLint and Prettier pass. The full TypeScript check still reports existing SDK API errors in unrelated files; it reports none in the edited files.

Implemented ZIP based cover archival in [archive.py](/app/openlibrary/coverstore/archive.py), with zero-padded paths, batch locking, upload verification, and database updates only after all four sizes pass validation. Cover retrieval now reads staged ZIPs or redirects to the stored archive.org URL. The [schema](/app/openlibrary/coverstore/schema.sql) adds `failed` and `uploaded` status; the [README](/app/openlibrary/coverstore/README.md) documents the layout and migration SQL.

**Verification:** 24 coverstore tests passed; 7 database-dependent tests were skipped. Ruff and `git diff --check` passed.

Existing tar batches can be reconciled to verified remote URLs, but their contents were not converted to ZIPs.

Added `flipt.is_auth_method(input, "jwt")` to the Rego authorization engines. It accepts the seven requested labels, maps them to the `auth.proto` method codes, returns false for a mismatch, and reports errors for missing authentication or unsupported labels.

Tests cover every label, the `k8s` alias, mismatches, and both error cases. `go test ./internal/server/authz/engine/... ./internal/server/authz/middleware/grpc` passes.

Implemented `storage.readOnly` in backend configuration and frontend types. Validation rejects the flag on non-database storage, including an explicit `false`. The UI now derives read-only state from the flag, applies the storage-type default when it is absent, and shows the active backend and a “Read-Only” badge with a matching icon. Authentication bootstrap also skips database access when authentication is disabled on non-database storage.

Added the requested [invalid_readonly.yml](/app/internal/config/testdata/storage/invalid_readonly.yml) and regression tests. `go test ./internal/config ./internal/cmd -count=1` passed. UI tests could not run because dependencies are not installed locally.

Updated notifications to render string content as sanitized HTML and give every notification link `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"`. Non-success notifications now deduplicate by an explicit key, or by text for strings and ID for React content. Repeated success notifications remain separate.

Added [notification tests](/app/packages/components/containers/notifications/Notifications.test.tsx). The focused Jest tests, TypeScript check, ESLint, and `git diff --check` pass.

The DynamoDB backend now accepts `billing_mode`, defaulting to `pay_per_request`. New on-demand tables use `PAY_PER_REQUEST` with nil provisioned throughput; provisioned tables use the configured capacity units. Startup checks an existing table’s billing mode and ignores configured auto scaling for on-demand tables, with a log message explaining why.

I updated the [backend code](/app/lib/backend/dynamo/dynamodbbk.go), [configuration docs](/app/docs/pages/reference/backends.mdx), and [tests](/app/lib/backend/dynamo/billing_mode_test.go). The regular DynamoDB package tests and focused AWS tagged tests pass. AWS-dependent integration tests were not run.

Implemented topic backlinks in the checked-out repository. Post creation and editing now call [Topics.syncBacklinks](/app/src/topics/posts.js), which updates per-post associations and adds or removes timeline events. Backlinks link to the referencing post, use its author, and appear only when the new admin setting is enabled. The timeline label and setting are localized.

Verification: 295 relevant tests passed; the focused backlink tests, ESLint, and `git diff --check` also passed.

Implemented the assistant formatting fix. The composer’s `messageID` now reaches model preparation, preview rendering, and editor insertion. URL placeholders restore links and images only for that message; unmatched links lose the link while keeping their visible text. The conversion also preserves link and image classes and styles, repairs nested lists, and keeps code block indentation.

All 14 relevant tests pass, focused ESLint passes, and `git diff --check` is clean. The repository type check still reports an unrelated OpenPGP type conflict in `packages/crypto/lib/worker/api.ts`.

Added ipset matching to the [iptables module](/app/lib/ansible/modules/iptables.py). It now accepts paired `match_set` and `match_set_flags` values, adds `-m set --match-set` automatically or alongside an explicit `set` match, and supports `!` inversion. Invalid or incomplete pairs fail before a rule is generated.

Added [unit tests](/app/test/units/modules/test_iptables.py) for rule construction and validation. All 26 iptables tests pass; `git diff --check` passes.

Added the current-session kebab menu with accessible keyboard controls, destructive sign-out actions, and automatic dismissal. “Sign out” uses the existing logout dialog; “Sign out all other sessions” passes only other device IDs to bulk sign-out.

The focused suite passes: **58 tests and 9 snapshots**. ESLint and stylelint pass. The full TypeScript check still reports existing SDK API errors in unrelated files; it reports none in the changed files.

Fixed the device limit crash. `RunAdmin` now returns the registered device when enrollment fails, and `printEnrollOutcome` handles a nil device. The fake service exposes a limit switch and returns an access denied error; regression coverage checks registration, denial, and recovery.

The enrollment and authentication tests pass. The focused `tsh` test could not build because the environment lacks required C headers; disabling CGO also leaves a dependency unbuildable.

Added bounded event polling to the card and PayPal creation flows. The hook calls the event manager every 5 seconds, up to 5 times, and can stop early when a `PaymentMethods` creation event arrives. It unsubscribes on completion and ignores late events.

Verification passed: 6 polling tests, 10 existing payment tests, type checking, ESLint, and Prettier.

Reserved tags are now configurable through `meta.config.systemTags`. Topic creation, editing, queued posts, and the REST tagging endpoint reject them for unprivileged users with **“You can not use this system tag.”** The `isTagAllowed` check also reports reserved tags as unavailable.

Verification passed: 169 topic tests, 153 post and category tests, ESLint, and `git diff --check`.

Updated the OSS migration to downgrade the existing `admin` role in place and mark it with `OSSMigratedV6`. Migrated users, trusted cluster mappings, and users created through the legacy CLI path now use `admin`, including records that previously pointed to `ossuser`.

The focused auth and service tests passed, the CLI package compiled, and `git diff --check` passed.

Implemented Project Runeberg support. Every work search document now exposes `id_project_runeberg` as an array, including `[]` when absent, while existing identifier fields retain their values. I also added the registered `ProjectRunebergProvider` and its [read button](/app/openlibrary/templates/book_providers/runeberg_read_button.html) and [download options](/app/openlibrary/templates/book_providers/runeberg_download_options.html) templates.

Verification: 56 relevant tests passed; Ruff and `git diff --check` passed. The format-specific Runeberg URLs could not be validated externally.

Updated [mathstuff.py](/app/lib/ansible/plugins/filter/mathstuff.py) so `min` and `max` forward keyword arguments, including `attribute` and `case_sensitive`, to Jinja2 when its enhanced filters are available. When they are unavailable, calls without keywords use Python’s built-ins; calls with keywords raise the specified `AnsibleFilterError`.

Added coverage in [test_mathstuff.py](/app/test/units/plugins/filter/test_mathstuff.py), including the mount size template expression. All 57 math filter unit tests pass, and `git diff --check` is clean.

Updated the certificate error wrappers. WebKit now accepts named `reply` and `errors` arguments, performs no reply operation during construction, and renders escaped errors as a paragraph or list. The shared decision API and Qt5/Qt6 WebEngine wrappers are integrated.

Verification: 38 relevant tests passed, including reply handling and HTML escaping checks. Qt6 wrapper behavior was tested with a mock; the available runtime is Qt5.

Added `samplingRatio` and `propagators` to tracing configuration, with the requested defaults and exact validation errors. Tracer startup now uses the configured sampling ratio and propagation formats; the config schemas and examples are updated.

Tests passed for `./internal/config`, `./internal/tracing`, and `./internal/cmd`. The offline run used a temporary module file because four versions pinned by the repository were missing from the local cache.

OCI bundle manifests are now configurable with `storage.oci.manifest_version: "1.0"` or `"1.1"`. The default is `"1.1"`; unsupported values fail configuration loading with the specified validation error. Bundle creation uses the configured version through `WithManifestVersion`.

The relevant Go tests passed, including checks of the generated manifests for both versions. AWS ECR was not tested directly.

Incomplete promise-item imports now look up staged metadata by ISBN-10 first, then by a B-prefixed ASIN. Enrichment runs before API validation, fills only empty fields, and removes placeholder values so they do not block backfilling. Validation accepts either a complete descriptive record or a titled record with a strong identifier. The batch script stages only incomplete items, continues after lookup failures, and records total and incomplete gauges.

Verification: 109 relevant tests passed, and Ruff passed.

Updated hosts-based blocking so a blocked domain covers its subdomains. The blocker checks each parent hostname against both block sets, while the blocking toggle and URL whitelist take precedence. Loaded hosts and request hosts with trailing dots are matched equivalently.

Added `widened_hostnames` and regression tests. Verification: 368 tests passed in the combined run; after the final test addition, the focused blocker run passed with 49 tests.

Added `-wp-ignore-inactive` to the report command and `WpIgnoreInactive` to the config schema. When enabled, [FillWordPress](/app/wordpress/wordpress.go:50) removes inactive plugins and themes from the result before WPVulnDB lookups. The filter returns `nil` if no packages remain.

Offline tests passed for `wordpress`, `config`, `commands`, `report`, and `models`.

Replaced the ad hoc expression parser with a validated AST in [lib/utils/parse](/app/lib/utils/parse/ast.go). It now evaluates nested string expressions, validates variable shapes and namespaces, enforces function arguments and expression depth, and uses the same regex compilation path for interpolation and matching. [Trait interpolation](/app/lib/services/role.go) and [PAM environment interpolation](/app/lib/srv/ctx.go) now validate variables through the new callback.

The parser tests and service trait tests pass. The server package test could not compile in this environment: the CGO build lacks `linux/hidraw.h`, and the CGO-disabled build lacks PKCS#11 definitions.

Centralized `add_db_name` in [catalog utils](/app/openlibrary/catalog/utils/__init__.py). Record expansion now generates an identifier for every author, using the name alone when no dates are available. Existing editions pass author names and birth/death dates into expansion, and the duplicate generators were removed.

Moved edition expansion into the public [`expand_record()` function](/app/openlibrary/catalog/utils/__init__.py) and updated add book matching, tests, and merge documentation to use it. The old `build_marc()` function is removed; `build_titles()` remains importable from its previous location for compatibility.

Validation: 82 catalog tests passed, 8 skipped, 2 expected failures; 17 utility tests passed. Ruff and `git diff --check` passed.

Updated the photo recovery hook in both the Drive app and drive-store. Recovery now loads regular and trashed items, waits for both to finish decrypting, adds only photo entries from the matching share’s trash, and succeeds only when no targeted items remain. Core errors mark pending items as failed. A persisted in-progress state resumes recovery on initialization.

Updated [linux.py](/app/lib/ansible/module_utils/facts/hardware/linux.py) to read `/proc/sysinfo` on IBM Z and include the five requested hardware facts in `gather_facts`. It returns `{}` when the file is absent, leaves undiscovered values as `"NA"`, and removes leading zeros from the serial.

Added regression coverage in [test_linux.py](/app/test/units/module_utils/facts/hardware/test_linux.py). All 21 hardware tests pass.

Updated [DeviceConfig.ts](/app/src/misc/DeviceConfig.ts) so loading a current config with a signup token makes no storage write. Persisted fields now live in one config object; migration preserves settings and converts credentials to a user ID keyed object, while memory uses a Map. All 13 targeted tests pass, and `git diff --check` is clean. The broader WebEngine suite aborted during Qt GUI fixture initialization, before running tests.

Added [icx_logging.py](/app/lib/ansible/modules/network/icx/icx_logging.py) with aggregate configuration, IPv4 and IPv6 host syntax, UDP ports, facility clearing, buffered levels, global logging controls, and idempotent running-config comparisons. Verification: 51 relevant unit tests passed, and `git diff --check` passed.

Added `@proton/metrics` to the mail app’s [manifest](/app/applications/mail/package.json) and [lockfile](/app/yarn.lock). Verification passed: 40 tests across the helper, label, and paging suites; TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier, and `git diff --check`.

Fixed ZIP timestamp handling in [unarchive.py](/app/lib/ansible/modules/unarchive.py). Updated Direct Dial heartbeat handling so SSH nodes advertising wildcard or loopback addresses use the control stream peer’s host while retaining the node’s SSH port. Focused tests and the full `lib/inventory` suite pass. The full `api/client` suite did not pass: two existing connection tests timed out connecting to `[::]` listeners, so I stopped that run after the failures.

Worksearch now requests JSON by default and reads facets, spellcheck suggestions, and work documents from Solr’s JSON response. The new facet processors preserve the required `has_fulltext` order and display values. I also updated the search error display and the existing tests.

Verification: **31 Worksearch tests passed**; `git diff --check` passed.

`FormatString` now accepts an optional `encoding` parameter and validates it during `to_py`. The user agent setting requires ASCII; format strings without an encoding constraint keep their previous behavior.

Tests passed: 1,140 config type/data tests and 206 config file tests. The web settings suite could not complete because `PyQt5.QtWebKit` is unavailable in this environment.

Updated [config/default.yml](/app/config/default.yml) with examples. `go test ./...` and `git diff --check` pass. Live Postgres and MySQL connections were not tested; the repository tests cover their generated connection strings.

Fixed the import issue in the checked-out repository. YAML imports now use the v3 decoder, so nested metadata and attachments deserialize into JSON compatible structures without an ad hoc conversion. `go test ./internal/ext` and `git diff --check` passed. The optional CLI package check was stopped during lengthy C compilation; that package has no test files.

Implemented `.well-known` `force_disable` for new rooms. The shared policy helper gives server force-on policy precedence over a conflicting `.well-known` force-off policy and warns when they conflict. The room dialog keeps encryption controls and creation disabled while the decision loads, then displays and submits the enforced value. Room encryption defaults also honor `force_disable`.

All 31 focused tests pass; targeted ESLint, Prettier, and diff checks pass. The full TypeScript check still fails on an unrelated error in unchanged [src/Unread.ts](/app/src/Unread.ts:167).

Updated [DataLoader](/app/lib/ansible/parsing/dataloader.py) so `cache='none'` bypasses the file cache and `cache='vaulted'` caches parsed vaulted files for reuse. Play `vars_files` now uses vaulted caching in [VariableManager](/app/lib/ansible/vars/manager.py).

Added regression tests in [test_dataloader.py](/app/test/units/parsing/test_dataloader.py). All 33 DataLoader tests and 8 variable manager tests pass.

Implemented OCI feature flag storage. The local refresh and subscription test passes. The relevant config, command, storage, and OCI tests pass with network access disabled; `git diff --check` is clean.

Fixed the user info panel’s Kick, Ban, and Mute controls in [UserInfo.tsx](/app/src/components/views/right_panel/UserInfo.tsx). Adjacent search results now merge into one timeline when their boundary event IDs match. The merged tile renders the shared event once, highlights each direct match, and links each match to its own event. Separate results remain separate.

Updated [RoomSearchView.tsx](/app/src/components/structures/RoomSearchView.tsx:217) and [SearchResultTile.tsx](/app/src/components/views/rooms/SearchResultTile.tsx:60). All 10 focused tests pass; TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier, and `git diff --check` pass.

Edition matching now accepts raw records. The shared expansion logic builds title variants, combines ISBN fields, handles missing author data, and preserves existing `db_name` values for author and contributor comparisons. I added regression tests for matching without ISBNs and for thresholds 875 and 515.

Verification: 13 focused tests passed; 2 existing tests remain expected failures. The broader add-book suite passed all 63 tests. Ruff and `git diff --check` passed.

Implemented the gRPC version interceptor and registered it in the server chain. It reads `x-flipt-accept-server-version`, accepts `v1.0.0` and `1.0.0` formats, stores the parsed version in context, and uses `1.0.0` when the header is missing or invalid.

Added coverage for context retrieval and header parsing in [middleware_test.go](/app/internal/server/middleware/grpc/middleware_test.go). Tests passed: `go test ./internal/server/middleware/grpc ./internal/cmd`.

Updated the port model so `vuls report` can parse legacy string `listenPorts` values. Verification passed: `GOPROXY=off go test ./models ./scan ./report` and `git diff --check`.

Implemented HA database service selection. The proxy now keeps all matching services, shuffles them through an injectable ordering hook, retries the next candidate when a tunnel has a connectivity failure, and returns a connection problem if none can be reached.

`DatabaseServerV3.String()` now includes `HostID`; server sorting uses name then `HostID`. `tsh db ls` deduplicates same-name services, and `FakeRemoteSite` can simulate outages by `ServerID`.

The API, reverse tunnel, database proxy, and `tsh` tests pass, including a new test for an offline first tunnel and for all tunnels being offline.

Forked worker display calls now travel through `FinalQueue` as `DisplaySend` events and are replayed by the parent strategy thread. Parent output is protected by a threading lock. I removed the worker’s shutdown redirection, arranged for workers to finish before the result thread stops, and added stdout/stderr flushing in `TaskQueueManager.cleanup`.

The relevant tests passed: **19 passed, 9 skipped**. A new fork test verifies that a worker can send display output even while the parent holds the display lock. `git diff --check` also passed.

Implemented native SQLite backups in the checked-out repository. Configuration now supports `backup.path`, `backup.schedule`, and `backup.count`; the CLI provides `backup create`, `backup prune`, and `backup restore --backup-file`, with confirmation for destructive actions. Scheduled backups also prune files to the configured count.

Added focused tests, and `go test ./...` passes.

Updated [incdec_number](/app/qutebrowser/utils/urlutils.py:562) to skip digits in percent-encoded triplets, preserve encoded URL components, reject invalid counts and negative decrements, and leave ports unchanged. It now defaults to the path and applies the request’s explicit **first match** priority: path, query, anchor, then host.

Updated the [tests](/app/tests/unit/utils/test_urlutils.py:618). The full URL utility test module passed: **351 passed, 1 skipped**.

Implemented chat allow and deny lists, a disable incoming messages setting, server-side checks for chat initiation and room creation, account controls, and an idempotent [upgrade](/app/src/upgrades/4.3.0/chat_allow_list.js) that migrates existing follow lists.

Verification: 356 messaging and user tests passed; lint and diff checks passed. Custom themes may need their own account controls.

Added optional `ident` support to the `password_hash` filter and both hashing backends. The password lookup now defaults to `2a` for bcrypt and saves the chosen ident beside the salt so later runs reuse it. Other algorithms ignore `ident`.

RemoteCluster now stores its status and last heartbeat. When tunnels disappear, it reports Offline while retaining the newest recorded heartbeat; removing a newer tunnel cannot move that heartbeat backward. The local update also preserves cluster expiry.

Regression tests passed for tunnel creation, updates, deletions, persistence, and expiry. The existing remote cluster and tunnel CRUD tests passed, and the cache and service packages compiled.

Updated the EOL data in [config/os.go](/app/config/os.go): corrected Fedora 37 and 38 dates, added Fedora 40, updated SUSE Desktop and Server dates, and marked macOS 11 ended while adding macOS 15.

Extended the Windows rollups in [scanner/windows.go](/app/scanner/windows.go) for builds 19045, 22621, 22631, and 20348. All added entries use named struct literals, and the prior mappings remain in revision order. Updated the existing tests and added kernel-version boundary checks.

The focused `config` and `scanner` Go tests pass; `git diff --check` also passes.

Updated [GUIProcess](/app/qutebrowser/misc/guiprocess.py) so finish messages name the process’s own PID and include the signal name for crashes. Verification: 173 tests passed, 4 skipped across the process, editor, and completion suites.

Worker calls to `display`, `warning`, and `deprecated` now send the method name and exact caller arguments through `_final_q`. The main process dispatches each call to the corresponding `Display` method, so warnings and deprecations share its deduplication state.

Focused tests passed: 14 passed, 1 skipped. An existing warning test passes alone but fails after another warning test because they share the `Display` singleton cache.

Centralized storage units in [size.ts](/app/packages/shared/lib/helpers/size.ts) and updated member allocation, organization setup, CSV import, shared limits, and other storage calculations to use them. Drive Pro and Drive Business now initialize storage at `sizeUnits.TB`.

Added `checkEventValidity` and `CalendarEventValidity` in [CalendarUtils.ts](/app/src/calendar/date/CalendarUtils.ts). The validator rejects invalid dates first, then starts before 1970, then equal or reversed start/end times.

Updated [galaxy.py](/app/lib/ansible/cli/galaxy.py) so implicit `ansible-galaxy install -r` installs both roles and collections from one file. Verification: 192 utility tests passed; 207 command tests passed and 1 was skipped.

Rules now accept `segment` as either a string or a `keys`/`operator` object. Verified with `go test ./internal/ext ./internal/storage/fs ./internal/storage/sql` and `git diff --check`.

Four Jest suites passed, along with ESLint and Stylelint. The TypeScript check still reports six unrelated errors in existing thread code.

Verification: 10 relevant tests pass; ESLint and `git diff --check` pass. The full TypeScript check still reports errors in unrelated SDK integration files, with none in the changed files.

Implemented zip based cover archival in [archive.py](/app/openlibrary/coverstore/archive.py). Covers now use zero-padded batch paths, verified uploads, batch locks, and database URLs that switch to archive.org only after validation. Legacy tar batches can be reconciled after their remote files are verified. The [README](/app/openlibrary/coverstore/README.md) documents the workflow.

Existing databases need the [upload-state migration](/app/openlibrary/coverstore/migrations/2026-10-17-cover-upload-state.sql) before using the new process. It was added to the repository but not applied to a database.

Validation: 23 coverstore tests passed, 7 were skipped; Ruff and `git diff --check` passed. Live archive.org uploads were not exercised.

Implemented `flipt.is_auth_method(input, method)` in [extentions.go](/app/internal/server/authz/engine/ext/extentions.go) and registered it with the Rego engine. It accepts `token`, `oidc`, `kubernetes`, `k8s`, `github`, `jwt`, and `cloud`, using the protobuf enum values. It returns a boolean for matches and propagates the specified errors for missing authentication and unsupported labels.

Added tests for all labels, the Kubernetes alias, mismatches, argument validation, and role based policy evaluation. `go test ./internal/server/authz/...` passes.

Implemented `storage.readOnly` as an optional config flag. Validation rejects either explicit value on non-database storage with the required error. The UI now uses the config to determine read-only state and shows the active backend in the header, with a backend icon in the “Read-Only” badge when active. Authentication bootstrap skips database access for unauthenticated non-database storage.

`go test ./internal/config ./internal/cmd` passes. The UI tests could not run because Node/npm are not installed in the workspace.

Notifications now render string HTML through DOMPurify, and links receive `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"`. Plain strings and React elements remain supported.

Non-success notifications deduplicate by an explicit key, string text, or notification id, in that order. Repeated success notifications remain visible. All 8 focused tests, the component type check, and ESLint passed.

The DynamoDB backend now accepts `billing_mode: pay_per_request` or `provisioned` and defaults to on-demand for newly created tables. On-demand creation omits provisioned throughput and skips auto scaling. Existing tables keep their billing mode, which determines whether auto scaling runs. The chart explicitly selects provisioned mode when its auto-scaling setting is enabled.

Local DynamoDB tests and focused tests under the `dynamodb` build tag pass. AWS integration tests were not run.

Implemented topic backlinks in the checked-out repository. Posts now create and remove backlink events as their links change, with per-post associations tracked in `pid:{pid}:backlinks`. The topic timeline shows localized “Referenced by” links to the referencing post when the new admin `topicBacklinks` setting is enabled; the setting defaults to off.

Updated the assistant content path to carry the draft’s `messageID` through model preparation, preview, and editor insertion. The relevant Jest suites pass, as do ESLint and formatting checks. The full mail type check still fails on an unrelated OpenPGP type mismatch in the untouched crypto package.

The forwarder now rebuilds request-specific sessions, caches only certificates with at least one minute of validity, and records audit events using its service context so client disconnects do not cancel them.

I also updated the forwarder config names, added `ServeHTTP` delegation, used `AuthClient` for heartbeats, and improved exec response error logging. **Verification passed:** `go test ./lib/kube/proxy ./lib/service` and `git diff --check`.

Centralized storage units in [size.ts](/app/packages/shared/lib/helpers/size.ts). Member provisioning, CSV import, organization setup, shared limits, and storage displays now use those definitions. Drive plans now start at `sizeUnits.TB`; the other requested defaults and slider steps use `sizeUnits.GB`.

**Verification:** 83 tests passed, including a new test for the Drive allocation. ESLint and `git diff --check` passed. Both package type checks still fail on an OpenPGP type mismatch in the unedited [crypto API file](/app/packages/crypto/lib/worker/api.ts:579).

Moved `extra_suffixes_workaround` to module scope in [webview.py](/app/qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webview.py). It adds missing suffixes for exact and wildcard MIME types only on affected Qt versions. `chooseFiles` now passes a deduplicated union as the third argument in its single superclass fallback call; the existing external picker path remains intact.

Updated the [webview tests](/app/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py). All 25 pass, and `git diff --check` passes.

Added `preview=true` to both import endpoints. Preview runs the import pipeline with UUID based temporary keys and returns `preview`, `edits`, and `cover_accepted` without saving records, uploading covers, or updating Archive.org metadata.

Author normalization and matching, language conversion, and case insensitive cover host validation now use the same logic in preview and regular imports. Preview reports cover acceptance; a cover ID is only available after an actual upload.

**Verification:** 165 relevant tests passed. Ruff and `git diff --check` passed.

InteractiveAuth now supports both stable and unstable registration token stages. The new [token entry view](/app/src/components/views/auth/InteractiveAuthEntryComponents.tsx:192) accepts Enter or a primary button click, prevents duplicate submissions, and shows busy and error states. The authentication flow retains the server’s advertised stage type and adds the session before sending the request.

The [new tests](/app/test/components/structures/InteractiveAuth-test.tsx:26) and existing auth tests pass: 9 tests total. Lint and formatting pass. The repository-wide TypeScript check still fails on unrelated Sliding Sync type errors; it reports none in the changed files.

Added `checkEventValidity` with distinct results for invalid dates, pre-1970 starts, and start times at or after the end time. Manual creation and ICS parsing now use it; imports reject invalid ranges instead of changing them.

Verification passed: `npm run test:app` (7,995 assertions), source and test TypeScript checks, and `git diff --check`.

Updated [ansible-galaxy](/app/lib/ansible/cli/galaxy.py) so an implicit `install -r` processes roles and collections in one run. Custom role paths and explicit subcommands skip the other type with the required messages. The change also handles empty requirements files, validates role file extensions, and processes role dependencies without reinstalling existing ones unless forced.

Added CLI coverage and updated the empty-requirements integration assertion. **All 122 CLI unit tests pass**, and `git diff --check` is clean. The integration task was not run because it installs from Galaxy.

`BlocklistDownloads` now inherits from `QObject` and emits `single_download_finished(object)` and `all_downloads_finished(int)` instead of taking constructor callbacks. Both consumers connect their handlers before starting downloads, including empty batches.

The relevant tests passed: **38 passed, 13 skipped**. The skipped tests require the optional Brave adblock dependency. `git diff --check` also passed.

Updated [configuration loading](/app/internal/config/config.go) to return `*Result` with separate `Config` and `Warnings` fields. Deprecation warnings now come from keys explicitly present in the configuration file before defaults are applied, including `ui.enabled`. The [CLI](/app/cmd/flipt/main.go) logs the returned warnings.

Verification passed: `go test ./internal/config ./cmd/flipt` and `git diff --check`.

Updated the assistant upsell flows to use the shared Scribe addon resolver and build `planIDs` consistently, including when a plan has no Scribe addon. Exported `SelectedPlan` and the resolver from the [payments/core entrypoint](/app/packages/components/payments/core/index.ts) and switched their consumers to it.

The relevant suites passed: **50 tests**. Formatting and diff checks passed. The components type check remains blocked by an unrelated `openpgp` type mismatch in [worker/api.ts](/app/packages/crypto/lib/worker/api.ts:577).

Fixed the Qt 6.4 dark mode mapping in [darkmode.py](/app/qutebrowser/browser/webengine/darkmode.py:297). A configured numeric text threshold now emits `("ForegroundBrightnessThreshold", "100")`; earlier Qt versions retain their existing key.

Added version-specific regression coverage in [test_darkmode.py](/app/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_darkmode.py:171). All 43 tests in that module passed with Qt’s offscreen platform setting.

Resolved the Red Hat OVAL issue. Scans now use the cached goval-dictionary v0.9.5 release with resolution data, propagate package fix states through HTTP and database results, and add advisories only when their IDs match the distribution. Red Hat family package CVE detection now uses OVAL instead of Gost.

Added regression tests for fix states, modular packages, advisory IDs, and both OVAL collection paths. The full offline `go test -mod=mod ./...` suite passed; focused tests passed again after the final modular resolution change.

Migrated [get_ia.py](/app/openlibrary/catalog/get_ia.py) from urllib to requests, including response validation, retry handling, UTF-8 default decoding, and `.content`/`.text` reads. Updated the shared helper’s callers in [marc_subject.py](/app/openlibrary/catalog/marc/marc_subject.py) and added focused tests.

Verification: 97 relevant tests passed; `git diff --check` passed.

Added [parse_duration](/app/qutebrowser/utils/utils.py:255) for decimal hour, minute, and second components, while preserving bare integers as milliseconds. Updated [:later](/app/qutebrowser/misc/utilcmds.py:45) to use it and reject invalid durations.

Verification: 194 tests passed across the affected unit test modules; `git diff --check` passed.

Updated the repository so rule `segment` accepts a string or a keys/operator object. Parsing rejects invalid segments, single-key segments use `OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR`, and exports use the canonical object form. Import, snapshots, SQL rule and rollout handling, and the requested fixtures are updated.

Verification passed: `go test ./internal/ext ./internal/storage/fs ./internal/storage/sql -count=1` and `git diff --check`.

The admin file upload endpoint now checks that the requested folder exists as a directory under the configured upload path before saving. Invalid targets return HTTP 500 with `[[error:invalid-path]]`.

Added regression tests for missing folders and file targets in [test/uploads.js](/app/test/uploads.js). The admin upload tests, ESLint, and `git diff --check` passed.

Added the reusable [ExternalLink component](/app/src/components/views/elements/ExternalLink.tsx) and [SCSS partial](/app/res/css/views/elements/_ExternalLink.scss), then migrated external links in settings, including the hosting link in [ProfileSettings](/app/src/components/views/settings/ProfileSettings.tsx). Links now have a decorative external icon, a screen reader new-tab cue, and secure new-tab defaults. The room permalink in [ShareDialog](/app/src/components/views/dialogs/ShareDialog.tsx) now has a descriptive accessible name.

ESLint, stylelint, and 36 relevant tests pass. The repository typecheck still reports unrelated `ThreadEvent` errors; the RoomSettings suite cannot load because this checkout lacks the generated `src/component-index` module.

Implemented `guessDateFromText` in [property.ts](/app/packages/shared/lib/contacts/property.ts:146) and wired it into [CSV import](/app/packages/shared/lib/contacts/helpers/csvFormat.ts:591) and vCard date conversion. It parses the requested formats, leaves unparseable dates unset, and preserves calendar values in vCard serialization.

Type checking passed, and all 14 focused contact tests passed. The full shared suite passed 871 of 873 tests; the two failures were in cookie expiry and empty-file base64 tests.

Added `utils.tokens` in [src/api/utils.js](/app/src/api/utils.js) for token creation, lookup, listing, updates, deletion, usage logging, and last-seen lookup. It stores token metadata and maintains the creation, ownership, and last-seen indexes. Bearer authentication now accepts these tokens while continuing to accept existing settings tokens.

Verification passed: ESLint, `git diff --check`, the full authentication suite (42 tests), and the focused API token tests (5 tests).

Added a per-user or guest-session posting lock for topic creation and replies. Overlapping requests now receive HTTP 400 with `status.code: "bad-request"`; the accepted request returns `status.code: "ok"`. A concurrency test confirms that only one topic is created and the related counters increase once.

Verification: 22 topic creation and reply tests passed; ESLint and `git diff --check` passed.

The lock is process-local, so deployments with multiple app workers need a shared lock for the same guarantee across workers.

Updated [qtargs.py](/app/qutebrowser/config/qtargs.py) so QtWebEngine combines CLI, `qt.args`, and configuration features into one `--enable-features=` argument. QtWebKit arguments remain unchanged. Added regression coverage in [test_qtargs.py](/app/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py).

Verification: 79 tests passed. One existing Chromium version test was excluded because Chromium refuses to run as root without `--no-sandbox`.

Fixed email confirmation timing in [src/user/email.js](/app/src/user/email.js). Pending checks now return strict booleans, `getValidationExpiry` returns the live TTL in milliseconds, and `canSendValidation` allows resends after the configured interval or immediately after expiry. The marker and confirmation record now share the configured expiry, with a one-day default.

Added regression coverage in [test/user/emails.js](/app/test/user/emails.js). ESLint, all 11 email tests, and all 259 user tests pass.

The calendar subscription modal now uses `MAX_LENGTHS_API.CALENDAR_URL` to block URLs over 10,000 characters. It trims input, uses one disabled state for both modal flows, and shows a single warning in the requested priority order. I removed the counter and input length cap.

ResizeObserver mocks now live in the components, calendar, and mail Jest setup files; the inline test mocks are removed. The calendar setup hook has the correct default-export mock in the new modal test, so the real hook does not run there.

Verification passed: 20 relevant tests, targeted ESLint, Prettier, and `git diff --check`.

Resolved the duplicate evaluation in `/app`. TaskExecutor now evaluates loop items once and resolves delegation before executing loop iterations. Item-independent targets resolve once per task; targets that use the loop item resolve once per item. VariableManager provides `get_delegated_vars_and_hostname`, Task provides `get_play`, and the loop cache workaround is removed.

Validation passed: 37 focused unit tests, five delegation integration playbooks, and `git diff --check`.

Implemented orphaned upload cleanup in [/app/src/posts/uploads.js](/app/src/posts/uploads.js) and the purge paths. Purging a post now deletes its uploads and resized copies only when no other post references them. Topic thumbnails follow the same rule. Administrators can retain files with the new **Keep uploaded files when their posts are purged** setting in the ACP.

`Posts.uploads.deleteFromDisk` accepts a path or list of paths, rejects other input types, and ignores unsafe or invalid paths.

Verification: **343 post and topic tests passed**; ESLint and `git diff --check` passed.

Updated [WPScan ingestion](/app/detector/wordpress.go) to use the first CVE as the canonical ID and preserve URLs, classification, fix version, and UTC timestamps. Enterprise descriptions, proof-of-concept references, introduced versions, and CVSS metrics are now included when present; absent or null fields leave optional metadata empty.

Added [tests](/app/detector/wordpress_test.go) for enriched, omitted, null, and no-CVE payloads. `go test ./detector` passed.

Added `isShareAvailable(signal, shareId)` to [useDefaultShare](/app/applications/drive/src/app/store/_shares/useDefaultShare.ts). It forwards the signal to `getShare` and returns `false` for locked or soft-deleted shares. [FolderContainer](/app/applications/drive/src/app/containers/FolderContainer.tsx) now redirects unavailable folder routes to the root.

Verification passed: 7 focused tests, including the existing default-share creation cases; the Drive type check; Prettier; and `git diff --check`.

Added per-server `nmap` scanning with the requested scan techniques, source port option, validation, and result parsing. Servers without an external scanner path continue to use the native scanner. The discover template now includes a commented `portscan` example.

`go test ./...` and `git diff --check` pass.

HTTPS support is implemented for the REST API, UI, and gRPC. [Configuration loading](/app/cmd/flipt/config.go) now accepts a YAML path, applies `FLIPT` environment overrides, preserves HTTP defaults, and validates HTTPS certificate paths. [Server startup](/app/cmd/flipt/main.go) loads the key pair before listening and uses TLS for both endpoints. The new options are documented in [configuration.md](/app/docs/configuration.md).

Verification passed: `go test ./...`. A local HTTPS smoke test returned 200 from the REST API, and the gRPC endpoint completed a verified TLS handshake.

Updated the SSH connection plugin to use resolved options for commands, file transfers, retries, and control paths. Reset now checks for a persistent socket with the effective connection parameters and sends `stop` only when the check succeeds. Removed SSH-specific core configuration definitions and added precedence and reset tests.

Verification: 96 relevant tests passed; `git diff --check` passed.

stages.handoff:
Token creation and deletion are now recognized audit events, including when configured through resource and action wildcards. gRPC initialization uses the audit checker to enable deletion logging only when `token:deleted` is configured. The auth server records the deletion event after the delete succeeds.

Focused checker and auth tests were added. All relevant tests passed: `go test ./internal/server/audit ./internal/server/auth ./internal/server/middleware/grpc ./internal/cmd`.

Added [`qcolor_to_qsscolor`](/app/qutebrowser/utils/qtutils.py), which returns `rgba(r, g, b, a)` for named, RGB, and RGBA `QColor` values. Wired it into the WebView and TabBar background stylesheet templates.

All 124 `qtutils` tests pass, and Qt accepted the generated RGBA string. TabWidget tests could not reach the changed code because setup fails on an existing float-to-`QSize` error; WebView runtime testing is unavailable locally because QtWebKit is not installed.

Implemented Best Book Awards in the checked-out repository: persisted nominations with read-status and uniqueness validation, award and count JSON endpoints, Work accessors, and redirect and account anonymization updates.

**Verification:** 52 relevant tests pass; Ruff and `git diff --check` pass. Existing databases need the included [migration script](/app/scripts/migrate-bestbook-awards.sql) applied when deploying.

Extracted role entry-point documentation into `RoleMixin._build_doc` in [doc.py](/app/lib/ansible/cli/doc.py). It returns `(fqcn, doc)` or `(fqcn, None)` when no entry points match; `_create_role_doc` now uses that result.

Added coverage in [test_doc.py](/app/test/units/cli/test_doc.py). All 20 unit tests pass, and the existing local-role and filtered collection-role output fixtures match.

Fixed module shebang handling in [module_common.py](/app/lib/ansible/executor/module_common.py:595). New-style Python modules now use their declared interpreter and arguments by default; explicit inventory or configuration overrides take precedence. Modules without a shebang fall back to `/usr/bin/python`, and the encoding line follows the shebang.

Added regression coverage in [test_module_common.py](/app/test/units/executor/module_common/test_module_common.py:108) and [test_modify_module.py](/app/test/units/executor/module_common/test_modify_module.py:38). The relevant executor and action tests passed: **84 passed**.

Moved `interpolate_color` and `_get_color_percentage` to [qtutils.py](/app/qutebrowser/utils/qtutils.py) and updated the download and tab progress indicators to call the new location. Added regression coverage for progress colors, invalid percentages, and color space behavior.

Verification: **344 relevant tests passed**.

Added `VulnInfo.KEVs` as a dedicated field with CISA and VulnCheck details. The detector now populates it from both sources, including XDB and reported exploitation records, and treats placeholder due dates as missing. KEVs are sorted for JSON output and counted in report summaries. The CISA alert field remains available for older JSON.

Updated `go-kev` to a locally cached version with VulnCheck support. Tests passed offline: `go test ./models ./detector ./reporter`.

MIME mappings and lossless formats now load at startup from [mime_types.yaml](/app/resources/mime_types.yaml). Operators can override it at `<DataFolder>/resources/mime_types.yaml`. The [loader](/app/mime/mime.go) registers the mappings through a `conf.AddHook` startup hook, and the UI now renders `mime.LosslessFormats` as a comma-separated uppercase string. The old definitions in `consts/mime_types.go` are removed.

Tests passed for `mime`, `model`, `server`, `core`, `server/subsonic`, `cmd`, and `scanner`.

Updated the MIME-suffix workaround to check **runtime Qt only** at both bounds: ≥ 6.2.3 and < 6.7.0. Clarified `version_check`’s `compiled` parameter and made `compiled=True, exact=True` raise `RuntimeError`. Added tests for mismatched runtime and compiled versions.

The 34 targeted tests pass. The full affected modules had 196 passes and two unrelated Qt 6.9 test failures.

Added [utils.parse_version](/app/qutebrowser/utils/utils.py), which returns a normalized `QVersionNumber`. The Qt checks, distribution version, startup minimum check, and crash dialog update note now use Qt-native comparisons.

The relevant tests finished with **420 passed, 4 skipped**. One existing Chromium initialization test was excluded because it abruptly exits in this environment. `git diff --check` passed.

Updated group and user image removal to delete local cover, thumbnail, and avatar files, including legacy and timestamped variants. Account deletion now cleans both user image types. Socket removal hooks remain in place, and missing files are handled gracefully.

Verification: 340 relevant tests passed; ESLint and `git diff --check` passed.

Updated [affiliate_server.py](/app/scripts/affiliate_server.py) with `PrioritizedIdentifier` for ISBNs and ASINs, identifier-only equality and hashing, a `stage_import` flag, and complete JSON serialization. Queue deduplication and batch processing now honor the staging flag. The former `PrioritizedISBN` constructor and `isbn` attribute remain available for compatibility.

Added coverage in [test_affiliate_server.py](/app/scripts/tests/test_affiliate_server.py). **Verification:** 35 relevant tests passed; Ruff and `git diff --check` passed.

Updated [db.go](/app/detector/vuls2/db.go) to validate metadata and schema version before returning a connection. A mismatch now forces a download, or returns a path-specific error when `SkipUpdate` is enabled. Connection, metadata retrieval, and nil-metadata errors also include the database path.

Added regression cases in [db_test.go](/app/detector/vuls2/db_test.go). The full `detector/vuls2` test package passes, and `git diff --check` is clean.

Implemented OS EOL checks in the scan path. The [canonical lookup](/app/config/os.go) uses the specified release dates, and scans now add boundary-aware warnings for ended, extended, approaching, and unknown support in the [per-target results](/app/scan/eol.go). The [summary](/app/report/util.go) prints each warning with `Warning: ` in evaluation order. I also centralized major-version parsing and improved Amazon Linux release detection.

Affected package tests passed. A repository-wide compile check and `git diff --check` passed, all with dependency downloads disabled.

Refactored the directory walker to use `fs.FS` throughout and return result and error channels. `Scan` now starts the walker directly, and `utils.IsDirReadable` has been removed. Added virtual filesystem and error-channel coverage in [walk_dir_tree_test.go](/app/scanner/walk_dir_tree_test.go).

Verification passed: `go test ./scanner ./utils -count=1` and `git diff --check`.

The repository already passed one `*sql.DB` to persistence and migrations. I configured its SQLite DSN with all seven requested settings, removed persistence’s fallback to the global database, and changed transaction callbacks to use their `tx` store.

The read/write interface and `dbxBuilder` requirements conflict with the stated goal of reverting that split, so I did not add them.

Tests passed: `go test ./db ./persistence ./core/scrobbler ./server`.

Updated [MARC author parsing](/app/openlibrary/catalog/marc/parse.py) to normalize names and dates and import deduplicated alternate names from linked 880 fields for 100, 700, and 720 authors. Added linkage tests and updated affected expectations.

Verification: 130 tests passed, 1 expected failure; `git diff --check` passed.

Updated [validation.py](/app/lib/ansible/module_utils/common/validation.py) so `check_type_dict` parses JSON, dictionary literals, and `key=value` pairs without calling `safe_eval`. Malformed inputs and non-dictionary results now raise descriptive `TypeError`s. Both `safe_eval` entry points are marked deprecated and emit Ansible’s version 2.21 deprecation notice; the [changelog fragment](/app/changelogs/fragments/deprecate-safe-eval.yml) records both.

All 118 targeted tests passed. A broader argument-spec run had two failures from accumulated global warnings; both tests passed when run directly.

Implemented the listed chat editing requirements: the v3 PUT route validates edits, checks message existence and permission, and returns the updated message. The client now uses PUT for edits; the socket path warns that it is deprecated. I also added the error translation, OpenAPI entry, and tests.

Verification passed: 79 messaging tests, 975 API tests, and JSON/OpenAPI validation. Full lint still reports pre-existing errors in placeholder handlers and unrelated lines.

The `DirectedGraph` description does not match this checkout: its application source contains no `LinkProvider` to refactor.

Replaced `:buffer` with `:tab-select` in command registration, tab completion, the default `gt` binding, help pages, and examples. Tab selection retains index, title/URL matching, count precedence, and cross-window focus.

Verification: 104 unit tests and 15 focused end-to-end scenarios passed. One existing flaky cross-window scenario remains skipped. The command registry contains `tab-select` and excludes `buffer`; generated help matches the checked-in documentation.

Resolved the user scoping issue. `UserPropsRepository` and its mock now require an explicit `userId` for every operation. LastFM reads and writes session keys for that ID, and the auth callback uses a short lived signed state issued to the authenticated user instead of trusting a URL `uid`.

Added two user isolation and callback tests. The full Go suite, targeted Go tests, UI lint and formatting checks, and `git diff --check` pass.

Added [netapp_e_drive_firmware.py](/app/lib/ansible/modules/storage/netapp/netapp_e_drive_firmware.py) with firmware upload, compatibility filtering, upgrade initiation, check mode, and optional completion polling. Added [unit tests](/app/test/units/modules/storage/netapp/test_netapp_e_drive_firmware.py).

The relevant test run passed: **23 tests**. API behavior has not been verified against a live array.

Resolved the pre-recording controls in [VoiceBroadcastPreRecordingPip.tsx](/app/src/voice-broadcast/components/molecules/VoiceBroadcastPreRecordingPip.tsx:32). “Go live” is now a native button that disables immediately and ignores repeated clicks or key activations until the start attempt finishes. Device selection remains anchored to the pip, closes after selection, and updates the header label. The [close control](/app/src/voice-broadcast/components/atoms/VoiceBroadcastHeader.tsx:68) now has an accessible name.

All 20 focused tests and 5 snapshots pass. ESLint and Prettier pass. The repository-wide type check still fails on Matrix client type errors in untouched files.

Voice broadcast liveness now comes from a single [info-state mapping utility](/app/src/voice-broadcast/utils/determineVoiceBroadcastLiveness.ts:19). [Playback](/app/src/voice-broadcast/models/VoiceBroadcastPlayback.ts:452) updates liveness only through `setInfoState`; playback actions and chunk arrival no longer change it independently. Regression tests cover the mapping, first chunk, and event emissions.

All 29 voice broadcast test suites passed (278 tests). ESLint and Prettier passed. The repository-wide TypeScript check still reports five errors in unrelated existing files.

Updated [forwarder.go](/app/lib/kube/proxy/forwarder.go) so session creation returns a clear `trace.NotFound` for a missing or unknown Kubernetes cluster, uses local credentials before service discovery, and dials remote and kube_service clusters through selected endpoints. The session’s selected address is also used for request URLs and audit metadata. Added coverage in [forwarder_test.go](/app/lib/kube/proxy/forwarder_test.go) for these paths and endpoint failover.

Verification passed: `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./lib/kube/proxy -count=1` and `git diff --check`.

Fixed the dark mode foreground threshold. The public `colors.webpage.darkmode.threshold.foreground` option is an Int with default `256`; [darkmode.py](/app/qutebrowser/browser/webengine/darkmode.py) sends its value as `TextBrightnessThreshold` before QtWebEngine 6.4 and `ForegroundBrightnessThreshold` from 6.4 onward. The old `threshold.text` name continues to work in saved YAML and `config.py`.

Verification: 437 relevant tests passed, one skipped. The Qt 6.4 behavior was tested with simulated version data; the installed runtime is QtWebEngine 5.15.2.

`detectScanDest` now returns a map of IP addresses to deduplicated, sorted port slices, including an empty map when there are no destinations. The port scanner now consumes that map. I updated the [destination tests](/app/scan/base_test.go:280) to cover multiple ports and overlapping wildcard addresses.

Validation: `go test ./scan -count=1` and `git diff --check` passed.

Lockfile scans now keep each file’s results separate. Vulnerability entries carry the lockfile path, duplicate CVEs retain findings from every file, and TUI and plain text reports resolve versions by both path and library name. I updated the pinned Fanal and Trivy dependencies for the required analyzer and driver APIs.

The affected tests passed offline, including new two lockfile and report regression tests. Every package also compiled successfully.

`SocketPosts.getUpvoters` now checks `topics:read` across every category associated with the requested posts before fetching votes. It rejects the whole request with `[[error:no-privileges]]` if any category is unreadable; administrators retain access. The method also resolves each visible UID once, preserves vote order, and returns a cutoff of 6 with at most five explicit usernames.

The [tooltip](/app/public/src/client/topic/votes.js) now uses the server’s cutoff, supports HTML, and escapes usernames. [Focused regression tests](/app/test/socket-posts-upvoters.js) pass, as does ESLint. The existing post test could not reach its assertion because Redis refused the connection at `127.0.0.1:6379`.

Tests passed for `utils/slice`, `core`, `scanner`, and `persistence`.

Implemented structured external profiles for Wikidata entities and displayed them in the author infobox. Wikipedia links use the requested language with an English fallback; Google Scholar produces one link per valid P1960 identifier. I also restored the author’s Wikidata lookup and added the three icon assets.

Verification: 38 targeted tests passed, and the infobox rendered the profiles in a local check. Ruff, Stylelint, SVG parsing, and diff checks passed.

Added [`luqum_replace_child`](/app/openlibrary/solr/query_utils.py:35). It replaces equal direct children in supported Luqum parents, preserves child order and sequence type, leaves missing children unchanged, and raises the existing `ValueError` for unsupported parents. Added coverage in [`test_query_utils.py`](/app/openlibrary/tests/solr/test_query_utils.py:37).

Verification: all 85 Solr tests passed; `git diff --check` passed.

Text output identifies the field; JSON output contains the complete structured result. Validation failures now exit with a clear `validation failed` message on stderr.

Added regression tests for misspelled keys, rollout bounds, missing fields, and both output formats in [validate_test.go](/app/internal/cue/validate_test.go). `go test ./internal/cue ./cmd/flipt` passes, and a manual JSON CLI run exits with failure and reports the rollout error at line 17, column 16.

Updated [BSD hardware fact gathering](/app/lib/ansible/module_utils/facts/hardware/freebsd.py) to calculate `uptime_seconds` from a numeric `sysctl -n kern.boottime` result. FreeBSD, DragonFly, NetBSD, OpenBSD, and Darwin now include the fact when that result is valid. The [shared sysctl parser](/app/lib/ansible/module_utils/facts/sysctl.py) now handles `=`, `:`, and space delimiters, preserves multiline values, and warns while continuing past malformed lines.

All 35 focused tests pass. The full facts suite had one timeout test failure; that test passed when rerun alone.

**Limitation:** Structured `kern.boottime` output, including output FreeBSD may produce, is omitted under the requested numeric-only rule.

Updated [GUIProcess](/app/qutebrowser/misc/guiprocess.py) to show stdout and stderr live and publish a final summary for each nonempty stream. Stdout summaries are informational; stderr summaries are errors; stdout appears first when both have output. Updated the mailbox list so requests wait for tracked backend actions to finish, and responses that overlap those actions are discarded. Workers and restart history differ; model times include waiting and local tests.
Active result usage only. Archived interrupted attempts and unrecorded usage are excluded.
